title: IT Manager
description:
Cellexia Labs currently serves customers in markets all over the world, with our fastest-growing communities in Europe, the US, Canada, and Australia. We’re a fully remote, international team, small by design, where everyone owns something real and decisions are made by the people closest to the work.



In a company with no office, IT is the office. Every laptop, login, tool, and file is how the whole team gets to work, and the whole business runs on it. When it works, nobody notices. When it fails, the whole team stops. Every new hire, tool, and market adds more to look after, and the companies that keep growing are the ones where someone owns it.



This role owns it, and leads the team that makes it work. You’ll keep our systems secure, our tools running, and our people productive, wherever in the world they log in from. You’ll set the standards, guide the IT team, and make sure new teammates are set up in a day, gaps are closed before anyone finds them, and the technology behind the business is something the rest of the team never has to think about.



For a sharp, driven technology leader who wants their work judged by results, this is a rare opportunity: a central role in how a growing brand runs.



A few examples of your responsibilities



Lead the IT team. Set clear priorities, divide the work, and give your team what it needs to do it well. You’ll coach people, review their work, and build a team that solves problems without waiting to be told.



Own the tech stack. Know every tool, account, and integration we run, who uses it, what it costs, and what depends on it. Choose and set up new tools well, and retire the ones we don’t need.



Keep us secure. Set the standard and make sure it’s followed: strong authentication, access controls, password management, device security, and clear rules for who can reach what. Teach the whole company to spot threats before they click.



Make onboarding and offboarding flawless. Make sure every new hire has working accounts, devices, and access on day one, and that every door closes the moment someone leaves.



Run a help desk that people love. Make sure problems across time zones are solved quickly, track the issues that keep coming back, and fix their causes for good.



Protect our data. Make sure backups are reliable, recovery is tested, and customer and company data is handled in line with the privacy rules in every market we sell in.



Look after our digital foundations. Keep our domains,
, website infrastructure, and tracking healthy, so our store stays up and our
s reach the inbox.



Automate the repetitive work. Build, or have your team build, the scripts, workflows, and integrations that save everyone hours.



Bring in AI safely. Evaluate and set up AI tools for the company, with clear guidance on what data can and can’t go into them.



Control the costs. Audit subscriptions and licenses, catch waste and billing errors, and work with vendors to bring costs down.



Write it down. Make sure how things work and how to fix them is documented, so nothing lives only in one person’s head.



Move fast without cutting corners. Use AI tools to speed up troubleshooting, scripting, and routine work, then apply your own judgment to make the final calls.



What we look for



Leadership people want to follow. You set a clear direction, delegate well, and give honest feedback that helps people improve. You hold a high bar without micromanaging, and you stay close enough to the work to help when it gets hard.



A security mindset. You think about how things could go wrong before they do, and you build habits and safeguards that hold up in practice, not only on paper.



Practical problem solving. You find the real cause fast, fix it cleanly, and learn something from every issue. You’re happy to dig into the unfamiliar.



Judgment under pressure. You stay steady when something breaks, make sound calls with incomplete information, and keep people informed while your team fixes it.



Clear communication. You can explain technical things to non-technical people in plain words, and your instructions leave no one guessing.



Ownership. You treat every system and every problem as yours until it’s solved. You hold yourself to a bar that keeps rising.



Team spirit. You support the best idea, not your own. You take feedback well and give it generously.



Relevant experience. [4+] years in IT management, systems administration, or a similar role, including [2+] years leading an IT team, ideally supporting remote or distributed teams at a growing company, with results you can show. Experience in e-commerce or consumer brands is a strong advantage. Excellent English is essential.



What we offer



Fast decisions, minimal bureaucracy. Your ideas are taken seriously here, whatever your title or tenure, and the best ones get tested.



Competitive pay, set for where you live. We pay well above local market norms.



Yearly bonuses of up to 40% of your annual salary. When the brand grows, you share in it.



Monthly and yearly subsidies to do your best work. Every month, we put money toward the things that make you more productive: wellness, focus, hardware and internet upgrades, and more. You know what you need better than we do, so you d
 how to use it.



Impact across the business. Every person on the team uses what you and your team build and maintain. You’ll see the whole company work better because of it.



A small team that moves fast. Good ideas get tested quickly.

Work from anywhere. Fully remote, with an international team and the flexibility that comes with it.



A path that grows with the company. As Cellexia Labs scales, the person who builds our technology foundations and the team behind them is the person best placed to lead it.



The selection process



We care about what you can do, not how polished your CV looks. That’s why our process is built around how you think and work, not just where you’ve worked.



Step 1: Apply. Submit your application and CV through this link: 

Step 2: Online assessments. Right after you apply, you’ll take two short tests: a problem-solving test and a personality test. The problem-solving test shows us how you reason through unfamiliar challenges. The personality test helps us understand how you work and whether the way we operate will suit you.

Step 3: Interview. If your results stand out, we’ll invite you to interview with the team.



We move quickly. The whole process, from application to interview invitation, takes a couple of days.



If you like the role and believe you could excel at it, don’t talk yourself out of applying. A less conventional background is welcome here if your results speak for themselves.



Before you apply



Cellexia Labs is a demanding environment. We hold ourselves to a high bar, and we ask the same of the people who join us. In return, you get real freedom, work that goes live, and a front-row seat to the growth of a brand.



If this sounds like the work you want to be doing, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply here:

. No Premiere project file is requested. Instructions and all test materials are supplied.

Start your application with CEREMONY and include:

4. Confirmation that you can reliably attend the initial training hours and complete assignments. If you have another job, please make sure the schedule is realistic before applying.

title: Detail-oriented Bookkeeper – Full-Time | Remote | AU
description:
We are looking for an experienced, highly organised and exceptionally detail-oriented end-to-end Bookkeeper to join a fast-paced Australian business.



This is a hands-on role for someone who stays on top of things in real time. You will be responsible for keeping financial records accurate and current throughout the day, monitoring incoming communications, reconciling accounts, identifying discrepancies and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.



We operate in a high-pressure, fast-moving environment, so we need someone who can keep up, remain accurate under pressure and proactively follow through on outstanding matters without needing constant reminders.



What You'll Do

- Complete daily bank and account reconciliations as a priority.

- Monitor the accounts inbox throughout the working day and action financial matters promptly.

- Monitor incoming customer payments and ensure invoices are marked as paid as soon as payment is received and verified.

- Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable.

- Prepare weekly payroll including setting up new staff in Xero.

- Process, check and allocate supplier invoices and customer payments accurately.

- Record foreign currency invoices.

- Monitor overdue invoices and proactively follow up outstanding payments.

- Identify and investigate duplicate payments, incorrect invoices, overpayments, underpayments and other discrepancies.

- Cross-check information rather than assuming transactions or records are correct.

- Review courier/freight invoices and compare actual charges against quoted freight and freight charged to customers.

- Identify unexpected charges, discrepancies and potential underquoting.

- Liaise with our accountant and respond to requests promptly.

- Maintain clear notes and accurate financial records.

- Follow outstanding matters through until they are fully resolved, not simply identified.

- Proactively flag anything unusual to management.



What We're Looking For

You must be someone who is:

- Extremely detail-oriented. Small discrepancies matter in this role.

- Able to work accurately in a fast-paced and high-pressure environment.

- Proactive and able to identify what needs attention without waiting to be told.

- Comfortable monitoring
s, payments and financial activity throughout the day.

- Able to prioritise urgent financial matters while still completing routine responsibilities.

- Confident in investigating discrepancies using the information and systems available to you.

- Comfortable asking questions when something doesn't look right.

- Strong at following up. If something remains unresolved, we expect you to keep it on your radar.

- Highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities.

- Reliable and consistently available during agreed working hours.

- A strong communicator with excellent written and spoken English.



Mandatory Requirements

* Proven professional bookkeeping experience.

* You must have a minimum of 5 years of professional Australian bookkeeping/accounting experience.

* Experience with Xero.

* Strong reconciliation, accounts payable and accounts receivable experience.

* Must have hands-on experience with Australian payroll, including setting up new employees and preparing/processing weekly payroll. 

* Must have a strong working knowledge of Australian bookkeeping and taxation requirements, including GST, BAS, PAYG and superannuation. 

* Must have hands-on experience processing and reconciling foreign currency invoices and payments.

* Excellent attention to detail.

* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills.

* Experience investigating financial discrepancies.

* Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

* Reliable computer, internet connection, and professional work-from-home setup.

* Ability to work effectively under pressure and meet deadlines.

* Ability to work full-time during Melbourne business hours.

* Must be a Filipino citizen based in the Philippines.

* To confirm that you have read the full job description and understand the requirements of the role, please include the word “OFFROAD” in the subject line of your application.



Highly Advantageous

*Experience with any of the following will be highly regarded:

*Australian e-commerce or retail businesses

*Shopify

*Inventory management/accounting systems

*Freight or logistics reconciliation

*High-volume transaction environments

*Working directly with external Australian accountants



This position requires constant attention and ownership.



This Role May Not Be For You If...



If you prefer waiting for tasks to be assigned, checking
s only occasionally, leaving discrepancies for someone else to investigate, or needing regular reminders to follow up outstanding matters, this role will likely not be the right fit.

We need someone who sees something that doesn't look right and thinks:

“I need to check this.” and not: “Someone will tell me if there's a problem.”



Working Hours

Shift Hours – Full-Time Monday to Friday

Melbourne Time: (AEST/AEDT): 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM

Philippine Time: (PHT): 7:00 AM - 4:00 PM (6:00 AM - 3:00 PM during AEDT)

Includes a 1-hour lunch break

Applicants must be able to consistently work Melbourne business hours.



TO APPLY

To be considered for this position:

You MUST submit an updated resume/CV.

You must have relevant professional bookkeeping experience.

You must have strong written and spoken English communication skills.

You must be comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.

You must be available during the stated Melbourne working hours.

You must be a Filipino citizen based in the Philippines.



Shortlisted applicants will be contacted directly regarding the next stage of the recruitment process.

Salary: Competitive, based on qualifications and experience



About Us



Capital Haus is a Sydney based financial services firm providing accounting, taxation and financial services to Australian individuals, businesses and investors.

This is an excellent opportunity for an accounting professional based in the Philippines to build a long term career with an established Australian business.

Assist with the preparation of Australian income tax returns.

title: Executive Virtual Assistant & Remote Team Operations Manager
description:
Location: Remote / Work from Home

Employment Type: Part-Time to Start (Potential for Long-Term Growth)

Compensation: Hourly – Please include your desired rate when applying

Schedule: Must have availability to overlap with U.S. Central Time



About the Role



I’m an entrepreneur managing multiple businesses and developing new business ventures. I’m looking for an experienced, highly organized Executive Virtual Assistant who has directly supported a busy founder, business owner, or senior executive.



This is not a basic administrative assistant position. I need someone who can take initiative, manage competing priorities, oversee remote team members, and turn ideas into completed projects without needing constant direction.



I currently have 39 business ideas that I want to bring to life, one at a time. I’ll provide the business idea, my vision, and the desired outcome. Your responsibility will be to help turn that vision into an organized execution plan, recruit the right people, delegate assignments, manage deadlines, and ensure the work gets completed.



You will work directly with me and play an important role in organizing and building multiple business ventures.



Key Responsibilities



1. Executive Support & Project Coordination



- Turn my notes, instructions, and voice messages into clear tasks, job descriptions, assignments, and deadlines.

- Organize priorities and keep projects moving forward.

- Anticipate needs and follow up on outstanding items without waiting for reminders.

- Communicate important updates, delays, and potential problems early.



2. Recruitment & Hiring



- Create professional job postings based on my instructions.

- Publish job postings on our hiring dashboard.

- Review applications, screen candidates, and conduct initial evaluations.

- Present a shortlist of qualified candidates with a clear explanation of why each person is a good fit.

- Coordinate the hiring process. I will make all final hiring decisions.



3. Remote Team Management



- Assign new hires an initial task with clear expectations, deliverables, and deadlines.

- Monitor progress and follow up with team members.

- Review completed assignments for quality and completeness.

- Address missed deadlines and flag performance concerns.

- Confirm that new hires can successfully complete their responsibilities before moving on to the next business idea.



4. Project & Task Tracking



- Maintain a shared Google Sheets tracker for all active assignments.

- Track the task description, assigned team member, deadline, status, and link to completed work.

- Keep documentation organized so I can easily review progress and completed deliverables.

- Ensure nothing falls through the cracks.



Qualifications & Experience



Required:



- Proven experience as an Executive Assistant or Executive Virtual Assistant supporting a founder, entrepreneur, business   owner, or senior executive.

- Experience managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

- Previous experience screening applicants and coordinating recruitment.

- Experience supervising, coordinating, or managing virtual assistants, contractors, or remote employees.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to work independently, exercise good judgment, and follow through without constant supervision.

- Comfortable using Google Workspace, especially Google Sheets and Google Docs.

- Experience working with hiring platforms, project management tools, or task management dashboards.

- Ability to handle confidential business information with professionalism and discretion.



Preferred:



- Experience supporting multiple businesses or business ventures.

- Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT and other AI-powered productivity tools.

- Experience creating standard operating procedures (SOPs) and improving workflows.

- Experience building and managing remote teams.



What Success Looks Like



I want someone who takes ownership of their responsibilities and treats this position as more than just completing a checklist.



Success means:



- I can share an idea or voice message, and you can turn it into an actionable plan.

- Qualified candidates are identified and presented without me having to manage the recruitment process.

- New team members understand their assignments and deliver work on time.

- Projects are tracked, organized, and easy for me to review.

- Problems are identified early rather than after deadlines have passed.

- Each business idea moves forward in an organized and measurable way.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. Introduction: Briefly introduce yourself and describe your experience as an Executive Assistant or Executive VA.

2. Executive Experience: What type of founder, business owner, or executive have you supported? What responsibilities did you handle independently?

3. Team Management: How many virtual assistants, contractors, or remote employees have you supervised or coordinated?

4. Problem-Solving Example: Give one specific example of how you managed competing priorities or multiple deadlines. Explain what the situation was, how you handled it, and what was accomplished.

5. Technical Skills: Which project management, hiring, Google Workspace, and AI tools have you used?

6. Hourly Rate: What is your expected hourly rate in USD?

7. Availability: How many hours per week can you commit?

8. Time Zone: What is your current time zone?

9. U.S. Central Time Overlap: What hours are you available to work that overlap with U.S. Central Time?



Important: Please provide specific examples of your previous work rather than general statements about your abilities. I am looking for someone with actual executive support and team coordination experience.



I’m interested in building a long-term working relationship with the right person, with opportunities to take on additional responsibility as the businesses grow.



If you are proactive, dependable, resourceful, and comfortable taking ownership of projects from start to finish, I would love to hear from you.

title: AI Video Editor — Short Form (Long Term, Room to Grow)
description:
We make short-form AI videos for health and wellness brands on
 and Instagram. You take a script we write, and turn it into a finished video using AI avatars.



What you'll do



Take a written script and a reference video

Create the video using AI tools (avatar, voice, b-roll)

Edit it, add captions, and submit by midnight PHT

Apply feedback so the next batch is better



You'll start with one avatar account (3 videos per day, Monday to Friday). Once you're consistent, you move to two accounts (6 per day). Weekends off.



Pay



$4 per video. At 3 videos a day that's about $260/month. At 6 a day it's about $520/month. Paid on time, every time, no exceptions.



This is a long-term position



We are not looking for someone for one month. My longest editor has been with me for four months and has never had a single complaint about pay, hours, or how they're treated. That's how I run things and it isn't changing.



There is real room to grow here. As we add brands and accounts, the people already on the team get more work and more money before anyone new gets hired. Roles above editing will open up too, and those go to people who are already here.



Who I'm looking for



Hungry. You want to get better, not just get paid.

Consistent. You hit deadlines every day, not most days.

Good instincts. You can look at a video and tell whether it's good, and say why.

Takes feedback well. I give detailed notes. Apply them and you'll move up fast.



Experience with AI video tools is a plus, but instinct and consistency matter more. I'll teach the rest.



How to apply — read this part carefully



Applications with no video attached will not be reviewed. There are two ways to show me your work. Pick either one.



Option A — recreate this video



Watch this video: 

Recreate it as closely as you can. Same structure, same pacing. Don't copy it exactly — make your version better if you see something you'd improve.

Send the link (Google Drive or Dropbox) and a short note on what you changed and why.



Option B — send work you've already made



If you've already made high quality AI videos in this exact style, skip the test and send those instead. Two or three of your best is enough. The video you submit should be on par with or better than this example video.



You must include proof you actually made them. Any of these works: the project file, the raw export before captions, a screen recording of your timeline, or a link to the account they were posted on. Videos with no proof will not be counted.



With either option, include:



The word BLUEBIRD at the start of your message, so I know you read the whole post

Your discord username — this is where we do all our work and communication

What AI tools you currently have access to, and which ones you don't



I'm hiring fast. I look at every submission personally, and if your work is genuinely good you'll hear from me quickly.

title: Long-Form Video Editor (YouTube / Podcast) — Full Time, Remote
description:
We're a US content agency hiring a long-form video editor for ongoing, long-term work. This is not a one-off project - we want someone who stays on the team.



WHAT YOU'D BE EDITING

Cinematic long-form content for our clients in the sales industry: podcasts, YouTube video essays, informational and tutorial videos, VSLs and webinar-style talking head. Movie-grade B-roll, animated text, scored throughout. Source footage is typically 1 hour or more of multicam podcast material that you cut down and build a story out of.



REQUIREMENTS

- Premiere Pro OR DaVinci Resolve as your primary tool. CapCut, iMovie and Filmora applicants will not be considered.

- Fully fluent written and spoken English. This is a hard requirement, not a preference.

- Strong story structure and retention editing - you cut for the whole watch, not just the first 30 seconds.

- Strong instincts for cold opens and title/visual/audio hooks.

- Available 11am-7pm Eastern Standard Time, 5-7 days per week.

- Able to ship 4-6 finished long-form videos per week.

- Strong communication and willingness to take direction.



THE ROLE

Fully remote and async. Training provided in week 1. Pay is USD 1,000-2,000 per month based on output, paid twice a month.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the word STORY or it will not be reviewed.

title: Part-Time B2B Cold Caller for US HVAC Companies (Arizona hours)
description:
We build AI phone answering for HVAC companies in Arizona. I need a cold caller to book short demos with the owners. I take the demos; you get me in front of them.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Call HVAC companies in Arizona from a list I give you

- Ask how they handle calls after hours, and book a 15-minute demo with the owner when there's a gap

- Log every call in our CRM. Calls are recorded so we can review them together and get better



HOURS

- 20 hours a week, Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 1 PM Arizona time (12 AM to 4 AM Philippine time)



PAY

- $5/hour, plus $10 for every booked demo that shows up

- Paid trial first: 3 days on live calls, paid in full whether or not we continue



YOU HAVE

- Cold calling experience (B2B or real estate are both fine)

- Clear spoken English and you're comfortable talking to US business owners

- A quiet room, a headset, stable internet, and a backup for power and internet outages

- The hours above, consistently



TO APPLY

1. Start your application with the word "Desert" so I know you read this.

2. Send a 60-second voice recording (link or attachment) of you reading this opener and handling the objection after it:

   Opener: "Hi, this is [your name] with Obra. Quick question, how are you all handling the calls that come in after hours?"

   They say: "We already have someone for that."

3. Tell me your backup for internet and power outages.



Applications without the recording won't be reviewed.

title: Reliable Revenue Assistant: US Insurance Billing, AR & Practice Support (Optometry)
description:
RELIABLE REVENUE ASSISTANT

Virtual Assistant: Insurance, Accounts Receivable & Practice Systems

Ocean Park Optometry | Santa Monica, California | Full Time, Long Term, Remote





ABOUT OCEAN PARK OPTOMETRY



Ocean Park Optometry is a busy, patient focused optometry practice in Santa Monica, California, where our promise is simple: See Better, Live Brighter. We provide advanced, personalized eye care including dry eye treatment, myopia management, scleral lenses, concierge eye care, and luxury eyewear.



We are building a cohesive, high functioning, elite team of eye care professionals to scale our business by providing outstanding customer service, products, and services. Every member of our team is professional in demeanor, speech, appearance, and actions, and that standard applies equally to our remote team.





THE ROLE



We are seeking a highly dependable, detail oriented Virtual Assistant to own our back office: insurance billing, accounts receivable, reconciliation, prior authorizations, documents, and contact lens order tracking. You will also serve as the backup person for our phone, text, and
 communications.



This role is more than task completion. You will be the guardian of our processes. You will verify that our systems are being followed, catch issues before they become problems, and proactively stop things from falling through the cracks. You will track key performance indicators (KPIs) that drive constant improvement in our processes, our business growth, and the quality of every patient's experience.



This is a long term, full time position for someone who takes ownership of their work, communicates clearly, and enjoys being an essential part of a collaborative team.





SCHEDULE



You must be available to work our California business hours:



- Tuesday through Friday, 8:25 AM to 5:30 PM Pacific Time

- Saturday, 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM Pacific Time



Please apply only if you can reliably work these hours and have stable high speed internet, a dependable computer with dual monitors, and a quiet professional workspace. Backup internet and power are expected.





PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



Insurance and Accounts Receivable

- Create and submit insurance claims accurately and on time

- Review insurance claims, payments, denials, and outstanding balances

- Post and reconcile insurance payments accurately

- Follow up on unpaid, denied, underpaid, or delayed insurance claims

- Maintain organized insurance billing and accounts receivable tracking spreadsheets

- Research claim discrepancies and prepare clear notes for the office team



Prior Authorizations, Benefits, and Documents

- Prepare and submit prior authorizations and track them through approval

- Verify insurance benefits and eligibility ahead of patient visits

- Prepare receipts, letters, forms, and other patient or office documents as assigned



Contact Lens Orders

- Place and track contact lens orders, status, invoices, and patient communication needs



Process Verification and Quality Control

- Verify that office processes are being followed consistently and completely

- Identify gaps, delays, and missing information proactively, before they affect patients or revenue

- Recommend and help implement process improvements



KPIs and Reporting

- Track and report KPIs such as days in accounts receivable, clean claim rate, denial rate, collections by aging bucket (30, 60, 90+ days), prior authorization turnaround, and contact lens order turnaround

- Maintain accurate spreadsheets, reports, logs, and administrative records

- Use data to highlight trends and opportunities for growth and a better patient experience



Communication

- Serve as the backup person for patient and office phone calls, texts, and
s, responding with warmth, polish, and professionalism

- Communicate proactively with the Practice Manager and team regarding urgent items, missing information, and next steps

- Assist with other administrative projects as needed





WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You must have excellent written and spoken English that sounds natural, polished, and professional to patients and United States based team members. You should be comfortable making and answering phone calls, and responding to patient texts and
s, and you will present yourself professionally on video meetings.



The right person is:



- Highly organized and exceptionally detail oriented

- Experienced with medical insurance billing, claims submission and follow up, payment posting, or reconciliation

- Comfortable with Excel or Google Sheets and able to keep records accurate and easy to review

- Proactive and anticipatory, able to identify an issue and suggest the next step without waiting to be told

- Systems minded, someone who notices when a process is not being followed and takes action

- Comfortable tracking metrics and using numbers to drive improvement

- Flexible and comfortable shifting priorities in a fast paced office

- Outgoing, warm, professional, and able to work well with different personalities

- Trustworthy, discreet, and respectful of confidential patient and financial information

- Reliable, responsive, and accountable for completing assignments on time

- Willing to learn optometry specific processes, including contact lens orders and vision insurance procedures



Experience with United States medical billing, vision insurance, optometry, ophthalmology, or dental insurance is strongly preferred. Experience with OfficeMate, ExamWriter, VSP, EyeMed, Medicare, Blue Shield, Aetna, Cigna, or Anthem is a plus, but not required.





TO APPLY



Please submit all of the following to 



1. A brief introduction explaining your relevant insurance billing or reconciliation experience

2. Your resume

3. A short voice recording introducing yourself in English

4. Confirm that the $5 hourly wage is acceptable

5. Your internet speed test results

6. A brief description of your insurance experience

7. One KPI you have tracked in a previous role and how it helped improve results



Include the words "Reliable Revenue Assistant" in the subject line of your application so we know you read the full posting.



Applications sent through the OnlineJobs.ph message system alone, without the items above, will not be considered.



We are looking for someone who wants a stable, long term role and takes pride in making an office run better every day. We look forward to working with you!

title: AI Video Editor for Meta Ads – Wellness DTC Brand
description:
About us



We're a fast-growing DTC e-commerce brand selling at-home wellness devices. Meta 
 and Instagram) is our main growth channel, and video ads are a big part of it. Most of our customers are 55+, so every ad has to be clear, credible and easy to follow.



The role



We're looking for an AI video editor who specializes in performance ads for Meta. Not an everyday video editor, and not someone who only cuts existing footage. You combine strong editing craft with AI video and image tools to create complete ads, from generated scenes and b-roll to the final cut.



Here's how we work: we handle the creative strategy and send you a script, a brief and a reference ad. You look at the reference, understand the format and why it works, and know exactly how to recreate it for our product, in our style. No step-by-step instructions needed. You bring the editing craft, a sharp eye for detail and real care for quality.



This is a long-term collaboration. We want someone who wants to grow with our brand, not someone who delivers a file and disappears.



What you'll do



• Turn a script, a brief and a reference ad into a finished video ad: recreate the structure, pacing and visual style of the reference, adapted to our product and our brand.

• Generate scenes, b-roll, product shots and UGC-style footage with AI video and image tools (such as Higgsfield, Kling, Veo, Runway, HeyGen or ElevenLabs) and combine them with existing footage.

• Work across many ad formats: UGC-style and testimonials, talking head, voiceover with b-roll, problem/solution, us vs. them, listicles, product demos, podcast or interview style, advertorial style and more.

• Make several hook versions per ad, so we can test which opening works best.

• Add captions, text overlays, music and sound that fit the brief and the brand.

• Check every video before you deliver it: spelling, numbers, ratings, claims and product shots must be correct and match the voiceover. AI output gets an extra check for distorted hands or faces, garbled text and product details that don't match the real product.

• Share what you see working for other brands on Meta.

• Turn around revisions quickly and keep clear communication with our team.



Must haves



• Hands-on experience making ads with AI video and image tools. You can show ads where a large part of the footage was AI-generated and still looks real and credible. You know which tool to use for which shot and how to keep characters and products consistent across scenes.

• You can recreate a reference in our style. We give you a script, a brief and a reference, and you deliver an ad that follows the same concept but looks and feels like our brand: our product, our colors and fonts, and a tone that works for a 55+ audience.

• Proven experience with Meta video ads for DTC e-commerce brands. You know what makes a direct-response ad work: a strong hook, a clear product in the first seconds, proof and a clear call to action.

• A track record you can show. A portfolio with ads you made for DTC brands, ideally with some context on how they performed.

• A real eye for detail. You catch a typo, a wrong number, text that doesn't match the voiceover or an AI glitch before we do. Nothing leaves your desk unchecked.

• In it for the long term. You want to get to know our brand, our products and our customers, and grow with us.

• Reliable. You meet deadlines, communicate clearly in English and handle feedback well.



Nice to have



• Experience with health, wellness or beauty products.

• Experience making ads for an older audience (55+).

• Experience with AI voiceovers and AI avatars.

• Motion graphics skills for simple animated text, product callouts and infographics.



Our hiring process



1. Review: we read every application carefully.

2. Trial task: shortlisted candidates receive a first paid task, based on a brief from our creative team.

3. Next steps: if the trial goes well, we continue with regular briefs and build a long-term collaboration from there.



How to apply



Please apply through our application form. It takes about 10 minutes:





If you can't see the link, send us a message here on OnlineJobs.ph and we'll share it with you.



Important: the first question in the application form asks why you'd like to work with us. Start your answer with these exact words: "Detail matters". Then continue with your answer as normal. This is the first question you'll see after opening the form link. It's important that you follow this instruction, because it shows us you've read this far. Applications without it won't be considered.

description:

The content creator also collaborates with nonprofit organizations, so the VA will help organize content and ensure deadlines are met.



We are looking for someone who understands current social media trends, can create engaging content for a younger audience, and can work independently with minimal supervision.



SHIFT:

Flexible Philippine daytime hours, preferably 2 hours per day spread throughout the workweek. Must be available early in the week and before the weekend to prepare content for filming. No fixed U.S. business-hour shift is required.



Duties and Responsibilities



1. Social Media Content Planning

- Research current trends, content ideas, and video formats for Instagram and TikTok.

- Develop engaging content ideas related to skincare, hair, nails, sun protection, and lifestyle topics.

- Plan and organize content for nonprofit collaborations and regular social media posts.

- Create thumbnails and video cover images.

- Review and revise videos based on feedback.

- Organize video files, drafts, and completed content.

- Prepare captions and publish approved TikTok content.

- Assist with scheduling content using Metricool or similar tools.

- Coordinate content approvals and provide regular progress updates.



Note: The content creator will continue managing her own Instagram posting and audience engagement.



Qualifications

- Proven experience in social media management, content creation, and short-form video editing.

- Strong understanding of Instagram Reels, TikTok trends, and audience engagement.

- Experience using video editing tools such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or similar software.

- Ability to create engaging hooks, scripts, captions, and content ideas.

title: Senior Creative Strategist
description:
Remote | Full-time | Up to €1,500/month fixed + up to €500/month performance bonus



We're looking for a senior creative strategist who can take a fast-scaling Meta ads operation to the next level. Not someone who needs a playbook. Someone who writes the playbook, builds the research systems behind it, and runs a pod of two editors to turn insights into winning ads, week after week.



About Wolf of Washington

Wolf of Washington is a Dutch-language investment platform built on one uncomfortable fact: US politicians structurally outperform the market, and they trade on information regular investors don't have. By law, members of Congress must disclose their stock trades publicly. That data is gold.

We collect those disclosures, analyze them, filter out the noise, and turn them into concrete trades our members can follow. Real trades from real members of Congress, push notifications when something relevant happens, no theory, no guru talk.

Paid Meta ads are our core growth channel. We spend serious budgets, test aggressively, and live or die by our creative. That's where you come in.



The role

You own the creative engine of our paid ads. You lead your own pod: you plus two video editors who execute your briefs. You decide what we test, why we test it, and when we kill it. Your job is simple to describe and hard to do: find winning ads faster than the market burns them out. You'll also lead briefs to UGC using trybe.

This is a senior role. You report directly to the founder, you get real budget behind your ideas, and you're judged on output: hook rates, holds, CPL, and ultimately new members.



What you'll do

• Build and run the research system: weekly analysis of our ad performance, competitor ads, winning content, and new angles, turned into a concrete testing plan

• Write creative briefs and scripts your editors can execute without back-and-forth: hook, angle, structure, references, all in the brief

• Manage and level up your two editors: clear briefings, sharp feedback, consistent output

• Analyze every test: what won, why it won, and what that means for the next batch

• Kill losers fast and scale winners harder: you own the testing cadence

• Find new angles when creatives die, before performance drops, not after

• Build SOPs so the creative process runs as a system, not on memory and improvisation

Who we're looking for

• Senior experience as a creative strategist in paid social, with proof: accounts you've grown, ads you've scaled, numbers you can show

• You've built systems before: research processes, testing frameworks, briefing workflows that outlived you

• You think in data, not opinions: you read hook rates, hold rates, and CPL before you form a take

• You've briefed and managed editors and know how to get great output from them

• Direct response DNA: you understand hooks, angles, awareness stages, and why proof beats promises

• You work independently: you don't wait for instructions, you bring the plan

• Fluent English

• Bonus: experience in finance, investing, or info products

Pay

• Fixed: up to €1,500 per month, depending on experience

• Performance bonus: up to €500 per month on top, based on results

• Fully remote, long-term role



How to apply

No cover letters. Record a Loom video (5 to 10 minutes) walking us through your past work:

1. The systems you built: research processes, testing frameworks, briefing workflows

2. How you do research: where your angles and hooks come from

3. Your results: real numbers from accounts or campaigns you've run

Show your screen, show real examples. We care about what you've actually done, not how well you write an application.

Send your Loom link to 
 with the subject "Creative Strategist".

title: YouTube Video Editor | Long-Form Content, Retention & Channel Growth
description:
We’re looking for an experienced YouTube editor who can turn raw footage into engaging, entertaining videos that people want to keep watching.



Our content covers travel, local markets, product sourcing, business opportunities, and life abroad. Videos include market walkthroughs, conversations, product discoveries, and real-world experiences.



You should be obsessed with details, understand YouTube storytelling, and care about helping the channel grow. We want someone who brings ideas, makes strong editing decisions, and learns from each video’s performance.

   - Video length: A minimum of 30 minutes per finished video.

   - Weekly workload: At least five completed videos per week.

   - Location: Remote.

   - Payment: Fixed price per completed video in USD. No hourly billing.

   - Opportunity: Ongoing work following a successful paid trial.



You must be able to manage this workload consistently while maintaining quality.



You will:

   - Find the strongest story, angles, and moments within unscripted footage.

   - Create compelling openings, especially within the first 30 seconds, that deliver on the promise of the title and thumbnail.

   - Build curiosity, maintain momentum, and create satisfying payoffs throughout videos lasting 30 minutes or longer.

   - Remove repetition, dead time, and weak sections while preserving useful context, humor, and the creator’s personality.

   - Use B-roll, music, sound effects, graphics, and captions where they improve the story.

   - Clean up dialogue recorded in busy markets and outdoor locations, balance audio, and maintain consistent color.

   - Check every video for awkward cuts, spelling mistakes, audio problems, and visual errors before delivery.

   - Review audience retention, opening drop-offs, average view duration, and other relevant YouTube Analytics with us. Apply those findings to future edits.

   - Proactively suggest improvements to hooks, story structure, filming, and future content.

   - Meet agreed deadlines, communicate progress, apply feedback, and keep project files organized.



You should have:

   - Proven experience editing long-form YouTube videos, supported by links to published work.

   - Strong storytelling and pacing skills, especially for travel, exploration, documentary, or personality-led content.

   - The ability to keep longer videos engaging while preserving natural conversations and reactions.

   - An understanding of how titles, thumbnails, and video openings work together to attract viewers and retain their attention.

   - Experience using performance data and audience feedback to improve your editing.

   - A habit of studying successful channels and keeping up with YouTube’s guidance.

   - Strong English comprehension, including conversational speech and humor.

   - The ability to work independently, solve problems, and explain your creative decisions.

   - Reliable equipment, internet, and availability to deliver at least five videos of 30 minutes or longer each week.



YouTube thumbnail design is a bonus. If you can create compelling thumbnails that communicate clearly on mobile and accurately represent the video, include examples.



Please review these channels as references for storytelling, pacing, and presentation:

   - Drew Binsky

   - Harry Jaggard

   - Collin Abroadcast

   - Spanian

   - Travelwithchris

   - China Mac TV

   - Barrett

   - Jack Bloomfield



Use these references to understand the creative direction while developing an editing style that fits our creator and audience.



To apply, please provide:

   1. Three links to live, published YouTube videos you personally edited. Prioritize relevant long-form examples and explain exactly what you handled.

   2. A brief breakdown of one example: how you approached the opening, pacing, and story, and why.

   3. Any performance results you have permission to share, such as retention screenshots or improvements across comparable videos. Explain the context and your contribution.

   4. Your fixed price per video in USD for a finished video of at least 30 minutes. State the raw-footage volume, finished-length range, and revision rounds covered by your price.

   5. Your thumbnail price, if offered, and whether it is included in your editing rate.

   6. Your editing software, time zone, availability, and typical turnaround time.

   7. Confirmation that you can consistently deliver at least five videos per week, each at least 30 minutes long.



We will agree on the scope, price, and deadline before work begins. Shortlisted applicants will complete one paid trial video of at least 30 minutes using supplied footage, with a fixed fee, clear brief, deadline, and agreed revision round.



We’ll assess storytelling, opening strength, pacing, technical quality, attention to detail, communication, and how well you apply feedback. 



Please be prepared to explain your editing decisions and verify your contribution to the portfolio examples you submit.

title: Lead Embedded / Mechatronics Engineer — Smart Hardware Prototype (ESP32, CAD, IoT)
description:
HappyMat™ is seeking an experienced embedded systems / mechatronics engineer to design HappyMat™ Prototype #1, a smart interactive doormat with pressure/presence sensing, a digital display, addressable LED lighting, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth connectivity, camera/speaker/microphone components, embedded electronics and a custom physical structure.



We are looking for one experienced engineer (or a small team with one named lead engineer) to design the full prototype: architecture, firmware, mechanical CAD and a mobile-web control interface. The physical build will be done in California, USA, by our local technician. You will work as a team with him and guide him remotely.



This is a hands-on hardware project, not a software-only assignment.



Scope of work



Define the overall prototype architecture and select practical off-the-shelf modules to reduce cost and development time

Develop the ESP32 (or similar MCU) firmware: pressure/presence sensing, addressable LEDs, digital display, Wi-Fi and BLE, plus camera, speaker and microphone integration

Design the physical mat structure and electronics packaging in CAD: mounting for the display, camera, sensors, LEDs, controller and wiring; protect electronics from stepping loads; keep it serviceable; prepare parts for 3D printing or CNC

Build a simple mobile-friendly web control interface that communicates with the controller (REST / WebSocket / MQTT / BLE)

Prepare the BOM, wiring diagrams and step-by-step assembly instructions for our technician in California

Lead remote troubleshooting, integration testing and the final functional demonstration by video call

Deliver all firmware/source code, CAD files, drawings and configuration files



Production certification and a production PCB are not required for Prototype #1. Commercially available development modules are encouraged.



Requirements



Hands-on experience with real physical hardware, not software-only projects

ESP32 or similar MCU; Embedded C/C++; sensors; RGB/RGBW LEDs; displays; Wi-Fi/BLE

CAD skills: SolidWorks, Fusion 360 or equivalent; enclosure design and electronics packaging

Web interface development for hardware control (JavaScript/TypeScript or similar)

Camera/audio integration is a strong plus

Good written English; available for video calls during Pacific Time hours (US)



Compensation

Fixed price: $700 USD for the complete scope. This is a fixed-price project, not a monthly salary.



To apply, answer the following:



Confirm that the $700 fixed price works for you.

Your estimated timeline (in days or weeks).

Show 1–3 physical electronic products or prototypes you personally built: what exactly you designed, coded or built, with photos, video, CAD screenshots or GitHub links.

Describe your experience with ESP32 and CAD.

Are you available for video calls during US Pacific Time hours?

If you are a team: the name of the engineer who will lead the work.



Start your response with “HAPPYMAT”. Generic or AI-generated proposals that do not answer the questions will not be considered.



An NDA and IP assignment are required before confidential HappyMat technical information is shared. All project files belong to the company.

title: Virtual Operations Manager — AI-Assisted Acquisitions (Remote, US Eastern Hours)
description:
About Jiffy Offer

Jiffy Offer is a Durham, NC home-buying company. We buy houses directly from sellers, and we are rebuilding our acquisitions operation around an AI-assisted system: AI agents handle first contact, underwriting support, offer presentation, and agreement drafting. We need an operator to run that system.



The role in one line

You are the quality-assurance layer and day-to-day operator of the system. The AI makes the calls. You check its work, keep every seller lead tended, run compliant marketing, and move deals from signed contract to closed disposition. This is an operations and QA role, not a sales or closing job.



What you will own

- Seller pipeline management and AI oversight (~15%): daily pipeline review; QA every AI output against its source (call recaps vs CRM fields) before any offer or agreement advances; catch missed callbacks and stalled stages; keep the pipeline clean; prepare founder approvals. You never approve an offer range or agreement yourself.

- Marketing execution (~30%): build and run compliant SMS campaigns to consented, scrubbed lists only; manage Meta Ads campaigns manually; report spend, leads, cost per lead, and appointment rate weekly.

- Acquisitions support (~20%): verify underwriting (ARV, comps, repair assumptions, MAO math) before offers go out; prepare offer packages for founder approval; handle seller escalations the AI cannot.

- Transaction coordination (~15%): own the contract-to-close checklist: signatures, EMD, dates, extensions, title coordination. Nothing closes late on your watch.

- Dispositions (~20%): coordinate assignment sales, prepare deal packages, market to the buyer list, track days-to-assign.



Must have

- 2+ years in real estate wholesaling or acquisitions. You must be able to recognize a bad comp, a bad offer, and a bad contract term when the AI produces one.

- GoHighLevel experience: pipelines, opportunities, workflows, conversations, documents. You will live in it.

- Previous experience launching and running SMS campaigns: building lists, scheduling sends, tracking results, and handling opt-outs.

- Obsessive attention to detail and a QA mindset. You check the system's work instead of trusting it.

- Excellent written English and clear, professional seller-facing communication.

- Able to work full-time on U.S. Eastern business hours, with reliable internet and a quiet workspace for seller calls.

- Discretion with seller data, contracts, and financial terms. Follows checklists and SOPs exactly.



Strongly preferred

- Transaction coordination experience (contract to close).

- Meta Ads Manager experience; SMS marketing compliance knowledge (TCPA, A2P, opt-out handling).

- Buyer / disposition experience in wholesale assignments.

- Experience managing or training other VAs.



Do not apply if

- You want a pure sales or closer job. The AI makes the calls; this job checks the AI's work.

- You need guaranteed deal flow to stay motivated. This is an operations role measured on system health, not personal closes.

- You are uncomfortable being measured daily on pipeline hygiene, QA catches, and deadline tracking.

- You cannot work Eastern hours, or you treat seller data casually.



Trial and growth

30-day paid trial, assessed on QA accuracy, pipeline hygiene, campaign compliance, and communication (not deals closed). Authority expands through gates at 90 days, 6 months, and 12 months, growing into full operational ownership including hiring support staff.



Compensation

Base pay plus milestone bonuses tied to performance gates. Not commission-only. Pay rates are discussed during the hiring process, not posted here.



How to apply (all steps)

1. Read the full job description: 

2. Complete the application form: 
 — resume upload, 30-60 second video link, and DISC results PDF.

3. Complete applications are reviewed within 48-72 hours. Next steps for advancing candidates: work samples, phone screen, video interview, working interview, references, and offer.

Main Responsibilities

, Expedia and other booking platforms

*

title: Senior Paid Media Planner (Google, LinkedIn, Meta, Programmatic)
description:
HIRING: Senior Paid Media Planner

Remote | Part-time (potential full-time) | 20 hours/week



We're hiring a senior paid media planner who still builds, launches, and optimizes campaigns themselves. This is a practitioner role, not a supervisory one.



ABOUT BUZZINSIDER

BuzzInsider is an MIT-born marketing and technology consultancy. We help brands and private equity firms build marketing systems that deliver measurable growth. Our work includes a private equity-backed portfolio of operating brands, healthcare practices, and graduate and executive programs at top-tier US universities.



THE ROLE

Your core focus is paid search, paid social, and programmatic for US graduate school recruitment. Healthcare experience is a plus, not a requirement.



You will spend most of your week inside Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Meta Ads Manager, and a DSP. You will own the results, and you will present performance, budget pacing, and next steps to client marketing and admissions leaders.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Plan: Turn client goals into channel plans with budget allocation, audience strategy, flighting, and forecasts for leads or applications.

- Build and run search: Structure accounts, keywords, bidding, and creative tests in Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Demand Gen, YouTube) and Microsoft Advertising.

- Build and run paid social: Manage LinkedIn and Meta campaigns end to end, including audience builds, lead gen forms, conversion setup, and creative rotation.

- Buy programmatic: Activate display, video, native, audio, and CTV in a DSP, including private marketplace deals, first- and third-party data, and brand safety controls.

- Measure: Own tagging, conversion tracking, and offline conversion imports so optimization runs on qualified outcomes, not form fills.

- Report and advise: Present performance and recommendations directly to marketing and admissions leaders.

- Raise the bar: Review the work of junior buyers, document playbooks, and bring tested platform changes into client accounts.



MUST-HAVES

- 10+ years of hands-on paid media planning and buying, with recent daily work in the platforms.

- Expert-level Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising, including large account builds, automated bidding, feed and audience signals, and Google Ads Editor.

- Expert-level LinkedIn Campaign Manager and Meta Ads Manager, including matched audiences, Conversions API, and lead gen integrations.

- Direct programmatic buying experience in at least one major DSP (The Trade Desk, DV360, or Amazon DSP).

- Strong measurement skills: GA4, Google Tag Manager, Campaign Manager 360, CRM-to-platform conversion feedback, and a dashboard tool such as Looker Studio.

- A record of managing seven-figure annual budgets across several accounts and hitting cost-per-outcome targets.

- Experience driving graduate enrollment for US colleges and universities. You should be fluent in the full funnel (inquiry, application start, submitted application, admit, enrolled) and comfortable planning around application rounds and deadlines.

- Skill reaching niche, high-intent audiences, including working professionals by field, seniority, and employer on LinkedIn, plus domestic and international prospects.

- Advanced Excel or Google Sheets for forecasting, pacing, and scenario planning.

- Clear writing and confident presentation to senior, non-technical stakeholders.



NICE-TO-HAVES

- Healthcare paid media experience (health systems, hospitals, provider groups, payers, or life sciences), including HIPAA-safe tracking (no protected health information in pixels, audiences, or CRM uploads), platform health-ad policies, and comfort with medical, legal, and regulatory review.

- Experience connecting media to admissions CRMs such as Slate or Salesforce, and working within the brand standards of a prestigious institution.

- Current Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising, or DSP certifications.

- Agency experience managing several client accounts at once.

- Experience with Search Ads 360, server-side tagging, or media mix and incrementality testing.

- A bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply through the OnlineJobs.ph Apply button.



Start your cover letter with this exact first line:

BUZZ MEDIA PLANNER



Applications without that line may be missed.



Please include:

1. Your years of hands-on paid media planning and buying.

2. The platforms you use daily.

3. The largest annual budget you have managed.

4. One campaign you personally built and optimized. Include the goal, your role, the budget range, and the result. A higher-education or graduate recruitment example is preferred.

5. Any healthcare paid media experience, if you have it. This is optional.

6. Your hourly rate in USD.

7. Your available hours each week, your time zone, and how those hours overlap with U.S. Eastern Time (ET).

8. A 3–5 minute Loom walking through an account or media plan you built. Do not include any client-confidential data. Paste the Loom link in your cover letter.



Shortlisted candidates will complete a short paid planning test.



BuzzInsider is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Hiring: GoHighLevel + Google Ads Conversion Tracking Specialist
description:
Hiring: GoHighLevel + Google Ads Conversion Tracking Specialist



Project Type: One-time technical audit, troubleshooting, and verification



Experience Required: Advanced GoHighLevel, Google Ads, Google Tag Manager, and offline conversion tracking



PROJECT OVERVIEW



I operate two businesses, Donovan England and Donovan Messner, using GoHighLevel for websites, funnels, CRM, payments, and automations.



We have already spent significant time configuring Google Ads conversion tracking. Most of the infrastructure is built.



I am NOT looking for someone to rebuild everything or manage advertising campaigns. I need someone who can audit, troubleshoot, correct, and PROVE that conversion tracking is working.



CURRENT SETUP



- Google Ads Manager account with separate business accounts

- Google Ads tags installed on GHL funnels

- Google Ads connected to GoHighLevel

- Meta Pixel and Conversions API already configured

- Google Ads conversion actions created for purchases and registrations

- GHL workflows using Payment Received → Add to Google Ads

- Dynamic purchase values configured

- Auto-tagging enabled



WORK REQUIRED



1. Audit Existing Tracking



Review Google Ads, GHL integrations, funnel tracking scripts, conversion actions, and purchase workflows. Identify configuration errors without unnecessarily rebuilding existing systems.



2. Verify Offline Conversion Tracking



Confirm that GHL correctly captures and preserves Google click identifiers (GCLID, GBRAID, WBRAID) and transmits eligible purchase conversions to the correct Google Ads account.



Verify whether Google Ads receives, accepts, and attributes those events.



3. Verify Purchase Conversion Accuracy



Check the following:



- FSMC individual book purchases (Books 1–4)

- FSMC complete book series purchases

- FSMC $5,000 Master Class purchases

- CCMC $2,997 Master Class purchases

- CCMC webinar registrations

- Business consulting purchases and appointment conversions

- Professional styling inquiries and bookings



Ensure purchase values are accurate and conversions are not duplicated.



4. Resolve Tracking Conflicts



Review existing website-based and offline purchase conversions. Recommend and implement the correct tracking strategy for each funnel.



5. Perform End-to-End Testing



Conduct controlled tests to demonstrate that actual conversion events reach Google Ads.



Use Google Tag Assistant, GHL execution logs, Google Ads diagnostics, and other appropriate tools to verify results.



Document which conversions have been successfully tested and which require an actual ad-attributed transaction.



REQUIRED DELIVERABLES



- Working Google Ads conversion tracking for all applicable funnels

- Verified purchase values and attribution

- No duplicate purchase reporting

- Written summary of issues discovered and fixes made

- Screenshots or recordings demonstrating successful tests

- Final verification checklist



IMPORTANT



I want someone with actual experience integrating GoHighLevel and Google Ads offline conversions, not someone who only knows how to install Google tags.



The objective is to complete and verify the infrastructure so I can confidently launch advertising campaigns.



PLEASE ANSWER THESE QUESTIONS WHEN APPLYING



1. Have you successfully configured GHL's Add to Google Ads workflow action for offline purchase conversions?

2. How do you verify that Google Ads actually receives and accepts those conversions?

3. Have you worked with GCLID, GBRAID, WBRAID, and Google Ads offline conversion imports?

4. Can you audit an existing setup rather than rebuild it?

5. What would you charge for a fixed-price audit, corrections, and end-to-end verification?



Please provide examples of similar projects you've completed.

WORK DETAILS

title: Bookkeeper - Australia
description:
Evisory is a Brisbane-based accounting and advisory firm built for the hospitality industry. Our clients are cafés, restaurants, bars and venues – businesses where margins are tight and things move quickly if owners aren’t on top of their numbers.

We’re in our clients’ files every day, so their books are always current and they can make decisions on real numbers. Bookkeeping is the backbone of everything we do.



We’re looking for a Bookkeeper to look after the day-to-day books for a portfolio of hospitality clients. You’ll keep files reconciled and up to date, run payroll, prepare BAS/IAS for review, and be a friendly, reliable point of contact for clients’ questions. You’ll work alongside our accountants and report to the Director.



What you’ll do

▪ Reconcile bank, credit card and clearing accounts in Xero daily, keeping client files current

▪ Process supplier bills, receipts and sales data, including POS and delivery platform reconciliations

▪ Run weekly and fortnightly payroll, including STP, super and leave, with award-based wages

▪ Prepare BAS/IAS and payroll reconciliations for accountant review

▪ Keep client queries organised and send them out on a regular weekly cycle

▪ Help clean up and catch up files for new clients

▪ Flag anything unusual in the numbers to the accounting team early



What you’ll bring

▪ 5 years’ bookkeeping experience, ideally in an accounting practice

▪ Strong Xero skills, including bank feeds, reconciliations and payroll

▪ Working knowledge of GST, BAS and payroll compliance (STP, super, PAYG withholding)

▪ Great attention to detail and the ability to manage several client files at once

▪ Clear, friendly communication with business owners

▪ Highly regarded: hospitality client experience, award interpretation (e.g. Hospitality Industry General Award), POS and rostering integrations, e.g. Square, Lightspeed, Deputy.

title: Short-form Video Editor (CapCut) - Football Top 5 Countdown Shorts
description:
Pay: $4 USD per approved video. Up to 5 videos a day once you're up to speed (we start at 1 a day).

Time per video: about 1 hour 30 at first, 45 min to 1 hour once you know the style.

Flexible hours, but videos go out every day, 7 days a week.



The job

Each video is a 70-85 second countdown of 5 players: a cut-out of the player on a black background, the list title, then the real match clip of every moment the narrator describes, with captions. You get the voiceover, the captions file (SRT) and a one-page PDF brief for every video, plus a short video guide that shows the whole edit step by step.



What you'll do

- Lay the voiceover first and trim every silence (never cut a word)

- Find the official HD match clip for every line, so the screen always shows what the narrator says

- Crop and keyframe each clip so the player fills the vertical frame (no black bars)

- Add captions and the intro title in our style (white serif, black stroke)

- Watch your edit back start to finish and run the self-check before you send

- Upload to the shared Drive folder and log it in your tracker the same day



What you need

- You've edited short-form videos (TikTok / Reels / Shorts) before: show us examples

- CapCut (desktop) and solid keyframing

- You can find and download HD sports highlights quickly

- You take notes once and don't repeat the same mistake

- Reliable internet and you can deliver every day, 7 days a week



Nice to have

- You follow football and know the players

- Experience with sports or countdown edits



How the trial works

1. Shortlisted applicants get one sample video to edit, due within 48 hours.

2. The best two get a paid one-week trial: 7 videos, one a day, $4 per approved video.

3. The best editor keeps the account, with steady daily work and room to grow into a lead role.



You don't need to be an expert. You need to follow the system, take every note and watch your work back.



How to apply

Send a message with DOMINANT at the top, a link to 2-3 short-form videos you've edited, and two or three lines on why you'd be a good fit. Applications without the keyword or a portfolio aren't read.

description:
General Insurance Claims and Administration Officer



Remote | Philippines-Based | Monday to Friday, 9:00 am - 5:00 pm AEST



**To Apply** forms.cloud.microsoft/r/E0B7NuXcmy



The General Insurance Claims & Administration Officer will provide claims and administrative support to a well-established general insurance broking firm in the Australian market. The role is primarily claims-focused: working under the direction of the Claims Consultant, you will help progress general insurance claims accurately and promptly through claims lodgements, insurer follow-ups, documentation requests, and record maintenance.



Alongside claims, the role provides policy-servicing and general administrative support to the broking team to keep the brokerage running smoothly day to day.





KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



** Claims Support **



Claims Lodgements

- Gather and collate the required information, then lodge new general insurance claims accurately and promptly through insurer portals and systems, in accordance with the Claims Consultant’s instructions

- Accurately record client issues, claim details, and relevant updates in the appropriate systems and CRM



Insurer and Claims Follow-Up

- Contact insurers, claims teams, and assessors to obtain updates on outstanding claims, including making follow-up calls and remaining on hold as required to confirm claim status, outstanding requirements, and next steps

- Follow up when responses, reports, assessments, or decisions are overdue

- Monitor insurer commitments and follow up agreed actions within the required timeframes

- Escalate delays, issues, or concerns promptly to the Claims Consultant



Documentation and Information Requests

- Request required claim documentation, including causation reports, damage photos, dates of loss or event, quotes, scopes of work, invoices, receipts, proof of ownership, repair or replacement information, and any other documentation required by the insurer

- Send follow-up correspondence to clients or relevant parties only as instructed by the Claims Consultant, and report progress on outstanding documentation

- File and record all information received accurately in the appropriate claim file and system



Claims Administration

- Monitor open claims and maintain accurate, current claim records

- Diary and action follow-ups to keep claims progressing

- Review insurer correspondence, identify outstanding actions, and prepare relevant information for the Claims Consultant

- Maintain organised claim files and save all correspondence and supporting documentation correctly

- Complete general claims administration and other tasks as directed by the Claims Consultant





** Policy Servicing and Administrative Support **



- Manage and service an existing portfolio of clients across Builders Warranty and Construction policies, including changes, amendments, cancellations, and occupancy permit submissions

- Prepare quotes, policy documentation, renewals, endorsements, amendments, and cancellations

- Assist brokers with assessing client needs and sourcing, negotiating, and placing suitable insurance policies with insurers

- Maintain and update client databases, policy records, and CRM documentation accurately and promptly

- Provide day-to-day administrative support to the broking team, including data entry, filing, and document management

- Handle and liaise with insurers on behalf of clients on policy and servicing matters

- Manage client enquiries professionally and efficiently through the firm’s approved communication channels

- Build and maintain professional working relationships with clients and insurers, within the role’s defined authority

- Identify and refer appropriate upsell or cross-sell opportunities to the broking team

- Follow industry regulations, internal procedures, and documentation standards

- Support the team with ad-hoc administrative tasks and projects as required





SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE



You Must Have

- 3 - 4 years of administrative or office support experience in general insurance, working for an Australian-based insurance broker

- Hands-on experience in general insurance claims lodgement and claims management (not life, health, or superannuation)

- Familiarity with general insurance terminology and insurer portals.

- Well organised and highly motivated, with strong time-management skills and the ability to prioritise tasks, manage multiple clients, and meet deadlines

- Ability to work well under pressure in a fast-paced environment

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a customer-focused approach

- Confident negotiation and problem-solving abilities

- Strong attention to detail and accuracy

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

- Ability to work independently and as part of a team



Nice to have

- Experience using Insight or Office Tech broking systems

- Experience managing or servicing Builders Warranty and Construction policy portfolios, including changes, amendments, cancellations, and occupancy permit submissions

- Understanding of insurance products, policy wordings, and risk assessment

- Proficiency with insurance broking systems

Canvas Management Group is hiring a part-time Sports Video Editor to cut fast, high-impact highlight reels of our football and basketball clients. Canvas gives athletes the canvas for their vision, on and off the court, and video is how we show it to teams, scouts, brands and fans.

• Reliable with deadlines and responsive to feedback

Tools and equipment

Candidates must have their own editing setup:

• Professional editing software: Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro or DaVinci Resolve

• Motion graphics: After Effects or similar, for spotlights, player tracking and stat overlays

• Mobile and short-form tools such as CapCut for quick social cuts

Nice to have

• Social media know-how: trends, hooks, captions and what performs on each platform

Stacked Property Management manages a growing portfolio of 70+ single-family and small multifamily rentals in St. Louis, MO. We're hiring a remote Maintenance & Turns Coordinator to own every repair request and every vacant unit from move-out to rent-ready.



What you'll do

• Run the turn board for every vacant unit and hand rent-ready units to our leasing agent.

• Get bids, add new vendors, and keep the vendor list current.

• 2+ years in property management maintenance coordination or work order dispatch

• Strong written and spoken English; comfortable calling US tenants and contractors

• Available Monday–Friday, 12–4 PM US Central (20 hours/week)

Nice to have
