Job Title: B2B Partnerships & Prospecting Specialist (Football/Soccer) – Remote, Full-Time



Compensation: 25,000 PHP base salary + monthly performance bonuses. Strong performers realistically earn 35,000 to 40,000+ PHP / month based on booked, qualified partner calls and active referrals.



ABOUT US

We are an established sports placement and career development platform run by active professional athletes and industry specialists. We assist top talent in securing trials, contracts, and roster spots internationally through an extensive global network of club decision-makers, scouts, and sporting directors across [Redacted] countries.



THE ROLE

We are looking for a sharp, proactive B2B Partnerships Specialist to help build, nurture, and scale our international referral network. Our target partners include independent 1-on-1 performance trainers, private high-performance academies, elite showcase operators, and regional talent media pages.

You will own top-of-funnel operations: researching target partners, executing structured multi-channel outreach, qualifying prospective partners, and booking high-intent alignment calls directly onto executive calendar schedules. You will also assist with onboarding newly signed partners and keeping our active partner network engaged ahead of key operational registration/transfer windows.

(Note: You will be building B2B relationships directly with coaches, trainers, and academy directors—you do not sell directly to individual athletes or run high-ticket consumer sales calls).



WHAT YOU’LL DO

* Research & Prospecting: Identify, screen, and score qualified target partners (private trainers, private academies, showcase operators, talent pages) across our key target regions.

* Outreach & Engagement: Build clean target databases and execute highly personalized, professional outreach campaigns via
, LinkedIn, and WhatsApp (preparing priority accounts for executive social media engagement).

* Qualification & Booking: Screen incoming partner inquiries, confirm alignment criteria, and schedule 1-on-1 partnership calls directly onto executive calendars.

* Partner Support & Onboarding: Assist newly signed partners during onboarding by delivering custom referral links, tracking setups, and concise 1-page partnership briefs.

* Transfer Window Cadence: Maintain consistent, structured communication and regular follow-ups with existing network partners ahead of primary global player registration/transfer windows (e.g., January & July) to ensure ongoing alignment.

* Pipeline & Data Management: Maintain meticulous CRM hygiene in GoHighLevel (GHL) and prepare monthly partner activity and bonus performance/payout reports.



WHAT WE NEED

* Language & Communication: Native-level written and spoken English with a clear, professional, and articulate tone suitable for communicating directly with international directors and head coaches.

* B2B Experience: 2+ years of hands-on experience in B2B outreach, lead generation, or appointment setting (must demonstrate the ability to write authentic, highly custom, non-spammy messages).

* Organizational Discipline: Exceptional CRM tracking, lead documentation, and calendar schedule management—ensuring prompt follow-ups and zero dropped leads.

* Self-Driven Mindset: Proactive problem solver who takes initiative to locate and evaluate high-caliber prospects rather than strictly relying on a fixed script.



NICE TO HAVE

Solid understanding of competitive football (soccer) development pathways and leagues across international markets.

Direct hands-on experience navigating GoHighLevel (GHL) workflows, pipelines, and contact management.

 campaigns, website updates, landing pages, and digital products.

title: Car rental Operations, Digital Marketing, Video Editing, Business Support
description:
Job Description: Virtual Assistant – Car Rental Operations, Digital Marketing, Video Editing& Business Support 



(immediate raise after 90 days when value, responsibilities and market data clearly outpaces your current compensation. Acquiring new skills, increased responsibility, loyalty and continuous good performance as a company and as well as an individual will also be well compensated)



About the Company



We are looking for talented, professional, and motivated individuals who are ready to grow alongside one of the fastest-growing car rental companies in Central Florida.



At our company, we value transparent communication, continuous learning, accountability, efficiency, and maintaining a healthy work-life balance.



We are seeking a versatile Virtual Assistant who can manage multiple responsibilities, assist with daily car rental operations, oversee digital marketing activities, and provide administrative and creative support for other business ventures.



This position is ideal for someone who is organized, tech-savvy, proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable learning new software and AI-powered tools.



Position Overview



The Virtual Assistant will play an important role in the company’s daily operations and continued growth.



Responsibilities will include managing digital advertising campaigns, generating and processing rental leads, assisting with existing customer accounts, maintaining rental records, coordinating vehicle maintenance, and providing customer support.



As you become more familiar with the company’s car rental operations, additional responsibilities will include managing social media content using AI tools (if needed), editing promotional videos, building websites, and also assisting with digital marketing strategies for other businesses as a lesser importance task to the car rental business. 



The ideal candidate must be able to manage multiple projects, complete assignments within established deadlines, communicate effectively, and maintain a structured weekly work agenda outlining tasks and priorities. 



1. Digital Marketing & Lead Generation



The Virtual Assistant will be responsible for helping generate new rental customers through digital advertising and online marketing strategies.



Responsibilities include:



* Managing and creating advertising campaigns through Meta Ads 
 and Instagram).

* Managing and creating Google Ads campaigns.

* Developing targeted advertising campaigns specifically designed to attract gig economy drivers, including Uber, Lyft, DoorDash, and other delivery or rideshare drivers.

* Creating advertisements that direct potential customers to the company’s website.

* Monitoring advertising performance, lead generation, and campaign effectiveness.

* Implementing SEO strategies to increase website traffic, improve search engine visibility, and attract qualified rental customers.

* Identifying opportunities to improve website conversions and turn visitors into profitable renters.

* Continuously researching and implementing new marketing strategies to increase company visibility and rental bookings.



2. Lead Management & Rental Applicant Processing



The Virtual Assistant will handle incoming rental inquiries and assist with processing potential customers before they become active renters.



Responsibilities include:



* Monitoring and reaching out to incoming rental leads.

* Conducting background checks using Intelius.

* Verifying driver’s licenses and reviewing applicant information.

* Contacting potential renters to confirm their desired rental start date and time.

* Following up with qualified leads to move them through the rental process.

* Entering new leads and customer information into the company’s CRM system, which operates similarly to GoHighLevel.

* Adding new customer conversions and updating their information within the company’s system.

* Maintaining accurate records of applicants, approved renters, and conversion activity.

* Providing timely communication and follow-ups to prospective customers.



3. Current Rental Management & Customer Support



The Virtual Assistant will assist with managing active rental accounts to ensure payments, rental agreements, vehicle compliance, and customer communication remain up to date.



Responsibilities include:



* Performing daily administrative tasks, data entry, and updates to existing rental accounts.

* Verifying weekly rental extensions at least two days before the next payment is due.

* Following up with customers regarding upcoming payments and overdue balances.

* Activating the vehicle kill switch when a payment remains unpaid 24 hours after its due date, in accordance with company procedures and applicable requirements.

* Sending weekly rental extension agreements to customers and ensuring electronic completion.

* Calculating and sending toll charges to customers at the end of each rental week.

* Monitoring vehicle usage to ensure renters remain within their permitted geographical operating areas.

* Providing customer support by answering incoming phone calls and text messages.

* Responding to customer questions, concerns, and rental-related issues in a professional and timely manner.

* Coordinating vehicle maintenance appointments with the company’s designated mobile mechanic.

* Keeping accurate records of rental activity, customer communication, payments, and vehicle maintenance and sending in a daily report at the end of the day.



4. Vehicle Administration & Business Systems



The Virtual Assistant will help maintain the company’s internal systems and ensure newly acquired vehicles are properly registered and organized across the necessary platforms.



Responsibilities include:



* Adding newly acquired vehicles to the company’s internal systems.

* Setting up and updating vehicle information within SunPass.

* Adding and managing vehicles through Connect Pro.

* Ensuring vehicle information is accurate and consistent across all applicable platforms.

* Entering expenses into the Profit Pro expense management system.

* Maintaining organized digital records for vehicle-related expenses and business transactions.



5. Social Media Management & Content Creation



Once the Virtual Assistant has developed a strong understanding of the company’s rental operations, additional responsibilities will include helping manage the company’s social media presence.



Responsibilities include:



* Creating engaging social media videos.

* Developing promotional content for Instagram,
, and TikTok.

* Creating marketing materials to advertise available rental vehicles and company services.

* Using AI tools to assist with content creation, captions, promotional graphics, and marketing ideas.

* Helping maintain a consistent social media posting schedule.

* Identifying creative ways to increase engagement, brand awareness, and customer inquiries.



6. Additional Virtual Assistant Services for Other Businesses



In addition to supporting the car rental company, the Virtual Assistant may be assigned projects involving other businesses, clients, and business ventures.



These responsibilities will provide opportunities to develop additional technical, creative, and digital marketing skills.



Website Development & AI Automation



* Building professional websites using AI-powered website builders and automation tools.

* Managing website hosting and domain-related setup.

* Customizing websites to meet individual customer and business needs.

* Implementing website improvements designed to increase customer engagement and conversions.

* Incorporating AI automation tools to improve business efficiency and customer interactions.

* Implementing SEO strategies to improve website rankings and online visibility.

* Optimizing Google Business Profiles to improve local search visibility.

* Developing digital marketing strategies to help other businesses attract customers and grow their online presence.



Video Editing & Social Media Content



* Editing short-form promotional videos for Instagram Reels and TikTok for businesses

* Creating engaging video content for businesses and their services.

* Adding captions, transitions, graphics, and other professional editing elements.

* Repurposing existing video footage into marketing content.

* Assisting with social media marketing strategies and content development.



7. Qualifications & Desired Skills



We are looking for someone who possesses the following qualities:



* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

* Excellent organizational and time-management abilities.

* Ability to multitask and manage several responsibilities.

* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

* Comfortable communicating with customers professionally.

* Experience with digital marketing, Meta Ads, and Google Ads.

* Familiarity with SEO and website optimization.

* Experience with CRM platforms and data entry.

* Familiarity with AI tools and automation platforms.

* Basic video editing skills or willingness to learn.

* Ability to learn new software and business systems quickly.

* Problem-solving skills and the ability to take initiative.

* Dependability, accountability, and a strong work ethic.



Previous experience in car rental operations, customer service, digital marketing, or virtual assistance is a plus.



8. Work Expectations & Performance Standards



We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their responsibilities and understands the importance of completing tasks correctly and on time.



The following expectations will apply:



* Maintain a structured weekly work agenda outlining responsibilities, deadlines, and priorities.

* Complete assigned tasks within established timeframes.

* Provide consistent updates regarding completed assignments and outstanding tasks.

* Communicate proactively when issues arise or additional assistance is needed.

* Maintain accurate records and keep company systems updated.

* Respond to customer inquiries in a timely and professional manner.

* Follow established company procedures and protect confidential customer and business information.

* Be willing to learn new systems, technologies, and processes as the company grows.

* Identify opportunities to improve existing workflows and increase operational efficiency.

* Maintain professionalism, reliability, and accountability throughout the workweek.



9. Growth Opportunities



This is an opportunity to grow with a company that is expanding its operations and developing additional business ventures.



The position will offer exposure to several areas of business, including:



* Car rental management and operations.

* Digital advertising and lead generation.

* Customer relationship management.

* Social media marketing and content creation.

* AI-powered business automation.

* Website development and management.

* Search engine optimization.

* Digital marketing services for other businesses.



We value individuals who are eager to learn, take initiative, and grow alongside the company. As the business expands, there will be opportunities to take on additional responsibilities and develop new professional skills.



Our Ideal Candidate



We are not simply looking for someone who wants to complete a few administrative tasks. We are looking for a dependable, motivated, and versatile individual who wants to become an important part of our company’s growth.



If you are organized, technology-driven, creative, and capable of managing multiple responsibilities while maintaining excellent communication, we encourage you to apply.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with us, contribute ideas, take initiative, and become a valuable long-term member of our team.

title: Remote Cold Caller – Appointment Setter, Path to Commission-Based Closer (Web Solutions Company)
description:
Job overview:



• Company: A web solutions company

• Location: 100% remote (Philippines-based)

• Type: Full-time, long-term

• Working hours: 9 AM to 5 PM US time (this is a night shift in Philippine time)

• Start date: We will contact applicants for onboarding starting immediately



About the role:



We are a web solutions company growing our client base through outbound calling.

You will cold call businesses and offer them a free, in-depth analysis of their website and their Google and AI search rankings. Your main goal on every call is to get the business to accept the free analysis. Your second goal is to book a call between the prospect and our founder.

You'll work from a simple, proven script. You won't need to sell services or explain technical details on the call. You just need to get the yes and collect the right details.

Over time, strong performers will have the opportunity to move into a commission-based sales role as a closer. This is a genuine growth opportunity for people who deliver results.



Key responsibilities:



• Make outbound cold calls to businesses from the lists we provide.

• Offer our free website and Google and AI search rankings analysis using our call script.

• Collect the prospect's details accurately: names, website,
, phone number, role, and their main website goal or pain point.

• Submit each accepted analysis through our booking form and website tool.

• Book calls with our founder for interested prospects, and for businesses that don't have a website yet.

• Keep accurate records of every call.

• Meet weekly targets for calls made, conversations, analyses accepted and calls booked.



Requirements:



• Near-perfect spoken English (non-negotiable).

• Experience in cold calling, appointment setting, lead generation, sales or customer service is a big plus.

• Confident on the phone and comfortable hearing "no."

• Self-motivated, persistent, organized and comfortable working remotely.

• Reliable computer/laptop, good headset and stable high-speed internet.

• Available full-time from 9 AM to 5 PM US time (a night shift in Philippine time). Exact hours may shift slightly depending on which US time zone we're calling.

• Fast learner and coachable.



Trial period and pay:



Every new team member starts on a paid trial period. Trial period will be paid at $8 per analysis accepted. The trial ends as soon as you get your first free analysis accepted by a prospect.

From that point on, you are paid $4 USD per hour, full-time.



What we offer:



• $4 USD per hour once you complete the trial period.

• Full-time, long-term, stable work with a growing company.

• A clear, simple call script. No technical selling required.

• Training on our offer, script, tools and process.

• All necessary tools and lead lists provided.

• A path to a commission-based closer role over time for top performers, with very high earning potential.



How to apply:



Only serious applicants who follow instructions will be considered.

1. Send your updated resume/CV.

2. In the first line of your message, write exactly: "I have near-perfect English and am available for voice interviews."

3. Record a short voice message (30–60 seconds, using 
 or a similar tool). Introduce yourself, explain why you're interested in a cold calling role, and show us your English speaking ability. Attach or link the audio file.



We will immediately review applications and reach out to selected candidates for onboarding. Thank you in advance to everyone who applies!

title: Chargeback & Payment Dispute Specialist — E-Commerce — $6/hour
description:
We are a fast-growing international e-commerce company selling consumer products across multiple countries.



We are looking for a highly organized, reliable, and communicative Chargeback & Payment Dispute Specialist to take ownership of our payment disputes and chargebacks.



This role is especially suited for someone who is excellent at:



Following clear SOPs consistently every single day.

Staying organized even when handling many cases at once.

Keeping accurate records and documentation.

Communicating clearly with other team members.

Following up when something is missing.

Managing deadlines without needing reminders.

Paying attention to small details.

Taking responsibility for their work.



We already have clear systems and SOPs in place.



We are not looking for someone who ignores processes, skips steps, forgets to update cases, or waits until the last minute.



We want someone who can take a clear SOP, follow it accurately, communicate when something is unclear, and make sure every task is completed properly.



Your main responsibility will be to fight chargebacks, collect and submit strong evidence, communicate with our Customer Support team, track deadlines, and make sure no dispute is lost because of poor preparation, poor communication, or missed deadlines.



What Success Looks Like in This Role



A successful person in this role:



Checks every required platform every working day.

Follows our SOPs without skipping steps.

Keeps every chargeback properly documented.

Always knows which cases are urgent.

Communicates immediately when something is missing.

Follows up with Customer Support instead of waiting.

Updates statuses so the rest of the team knows what is happening.

Completes evidence before deadlines.

Double-checks their work before submitting.

Asks questions when something is unclear rather than guessing.

Takes ownership of problems until they are resolved.



Communication and organization are extremely important in this position.



If you notice a problem, we expect you to communicate it.



If you are waiting for information, we expect you to follow up.



If you cannot complete something, we expect you to explain why.



We never want issues to be ignored or left unresolved without communication.



1. Daily Chargeback Monitoring



You will monitor payment disputes across platforms such as:



Shopify Payments

PayPal

Airwallex

Mollie

Other payment providers we use



Your responsibilities include:



Check all payment platforms every working day.

Identify all new disputes.

Log every dispute immediately.

Record the dispute reason.

Record the dispute amount.

Record the evidence deadline.

Keep the status of every dispute updated.

Follow our chargeback SOP for every case.

Prioritize disputes based on deadlines.

Follow up on open disputes.

Track whether disputes are won or lost.

Communicate immediately if there is an issue you cannot solve.



No chargeback should ever be lost because someone forgot about it, skipped a step, failed to communicate, or missed a deadline.



2. Prepare & Submit Chargeback Evidence



You will prepare strong evidence for each dispute.



Depending on the dispute, evidence may include:



Order information

Customer information

Billing and shipping information

Tracking information

Proof of delivery

Shipping confirmation

Customer communication

Customer Support conversations

Refund history

Store policies

Refund policies

Shipping policies

Terms & Conditions

Screenshots

Product information

Other supporting evidence relevant to the case



You will be given clear SOPs explaining how different chargeback types should be handled.



We expect you to follow those SOPs carefully.



At the same time, you must understand the case you are working on.



Do not blindly copy and paste evidence.



Read the information.



Understand what the customer is claiming.



Make sure the evidence actually supports our case.



Double-check everything before submitting.



3. Communicate With the Customer Support Team



Communication with our Customer Support team is a very important part of this role.



You may need Customer Support to:



Contact a customer.

Send you missing information.

Explain what happened in a case.

Resolve a customer issue.

Ask a customer to collect their package.

Ask a customer to close a dispute after their issue has been resolved.

Provide screenshots or previous conversations.

Confirm whether a refund or reshipment was issued.



We expect you to communicate clearly and professionally.



Do not simply send a message and forget about it.



If you are waiting for information, follow up.



If something is urgent, make that clear.



If a deadline is approaching, communicate it.



If Customer Support has made a mistake that affects a chargeback, report it clearly so it can be corrected.



Good communication is one of the most important skills for this role.



4. Investigate Every Chargeback



Before submitting evidence, you should understand the full situation.



You should review:



The entire customer conversation.

Order history.

Tracking history.

Delivery status.

Previous refunds or reshipments.

Customer claims.

Internal notes.

Relevant company policies.



Do not make assumptions.



Do not skip information because you are in a hurry.



Follow the investigation process in our SOP and make sure you understand what happened before making a decision.



5. Deadline Management



You will often handle many disputes at the same time.



Being organized is therefore extremely important.



You will be responsible for:



Recording every deadline correctly.

Keeping an organized list of open cases.

Prioritizing urgent disputes.

Preparing evidence early.

Following up when information is missing.

Escalating problems before they become urgent.

Making sure nothing gets forgotten.



You should never need management to remind you that a chargeback deadline is approaching.



Managing your workload and deadlines is your responsibility.



6. Documentation & Organization



Every chargeback must be properly documented.



We expect you to keep clear records showing:



What happened.

What the customer claimed.

What evidence was collected.

What actions were taken.

Whether Customer Support was contacted.

What information is still missing.

When evidence was submitted.

The final dispute outcome.



Another team member should be able to open your documentation and immediately understand the status of the case.



If your work is not documented, it is considered incomplete.



7. Track Chargeback Results



You will track dispute outcomes and help us understand why we win or lose cases.



You should track things such as:



Chargeback reason.

Payment provider.

Amount.

Evidence submitted.

Outcome.

Win rate.

Reasons for losses when identifiable.



If you notice repeated problems, communicate them to management.



For example:



Customers frequently dispute delayed packages.

A specific shipping method creates many disputes.

Customer Support is handling a situation incorrectly.

Certain evidence is missing repeatedly.

We are repeatedly losing one specific type of dispute.



We want someone who notices patterns and communicates them clearly.



8. Improve Our Chargeback Process



Our SOPs are important, but they should also improve over time.



If you notice:



A repeated mistake.

An unclear SOP.

A missing step.

A better evidence structure.

A recurring communication problem.

A process that is causing unnecessary chargebacks.



You should report it.



We want someone who can follow systems extremely well while also helping us improve them.



Daily Responsibilities



Every working day you should:



Check all payment processors.

Identify new disputes.

Log all new chargebacks.

Review upcoming deadlines.

Work through active cases.

Follow the correct SOP for every dispute.

Collect missing evidence.

Communicate with Customer Support when necessary.

Follow up on unanswered requests.

Submit completed evidence.

Double-check submissions.

Update dispute statuses.

Track wins and losses.

Report urgent issues.

Make sure there are no forgotten cases.

IMPORTANT



To confirm that you have carefully read this entire job description, please start your application with the words:



CHARGEBACK SPECIALIST



Applications that do not begin with these words will not be reviewed.



What We Are Looking For



The most important qualities for this position are:



Extremely Organized



You should be comfortable handling many active cases without losing track of deadlines, follow-ups, or missing information.



Excellent at Following SOPs



We have clear processes for how work should be completed.



We need someone who can follow instructions consistently every day.



Not just during the first week.



Not only when someone is checking.



Every single day.



You should not skip steps because you believe they are unnecessary.



If an SOP is unclear, communicate with us instead of guessing.



Strong Communication



You will communicate regularly with Customer Support and management.



We expect you to:



Respond clearly.

Ask questions when necessary.

Follow up.

Communicate problems early.

Explain what you need from another team member.

Keep people updated on important cases.



Ignoring a problem is never acceptable.



Reliable



If you are responsible for something, we expect it to get done.



We should not need to repeatedly remind you about your responsibilities.



Detail-Oriented



Small mistakes in chargebacks can cost the company money.



You must be comfortable checking details carefully and reviewing your work before submission.



Proactive



If something is missing, investigate it.



If someone has not responded, follow up.



If a deadline is approaching, act early.



If you notice a repeated problem, report it.



Do not wait until someone tells you what to do.



Experience



Previous experience handling chargebacks or payment disputes is strongly preferred.



Experience with any of the following is a major advantage:



Shopify

Shopify Payments

PayPal

Airwallex

Mollie

Gorgias

Gmail

Slack

Google Sheets

Excel

WhatsApp

Performance Expectations



Your performance will be evaluated based on:



Following SOPs correctly.

No missed chargeback deadlines.

Accuracy of evidence submissions.

Quality of evidence.

Organization.

Documentation quality.

Communication with Customer Support.

Following up properly.

Reliability.

Attention to detail.

Ability to manage many cases at once.

Chargeback win rate.

Ability to identify and communicate repeated problems.



We care heavily about consistency.



Doing a good job one day and becoming disorganized the next week is not enough.



We are looking for someone who can maintain the same high standard every working day.



Salary



$6 USD/hour



Full-time position: approximately 40 hours per week.



There is potential for increased responsibility, performance bonuses, and salary growth for someone who consistently performs at a high level.



How to Apply



Please include:



Tell us about yourself.

Describe your previous chargeback or payment dispute experience.

Which payment processors have you handled disputes with?

Have you used Shopify before?

Have you worked with PayPal disputes?

Approximately how many chargebacks have you handled?

How do you organize multiple cases and deadlines?

Give an example of a job where you had to follow detailed SOPs every day.

What would you do if an SOP was unclear?

What would you do if you needed information from another employee and they did not respond?

What evidence would you use for a "Product Not Received" dispute?

What evidence would you use for a "Fraudulent Transaction" dispute?

Which software platforms have you used?

When can you start?



Please also record a 2–3 minute Loom video introducing yourself and explaining why you believe you would be a good fit for this position.



Interview Questions

Question 1



You have 30 active chargebacks across four different payment providers.



Five deadlines are within the next three days.



Explain exactly how you would organize your work.



Question 2



Our SOP says that before submitting a "Product Not Received" chargeback, you must review tracking, the entire customer conversation, and any previous refunds.



You are very busy and tracking already shows "Delivered."



Would you still complete the other steps?



Explain why.



Question 3



You need information from a Customer Support agent to complete evidence.



You message them, but they have not responded after several hours and the evidence deadline is tomorrow.



What would you do?



Question 4



A customer opens a chargeback claiming that they never received their order.



Tracking shows that the order was delivered.



Walk us through exactly what you would investigate and what evidence you would submit.



Question 5



You realize you made a mistake on a case.



What would you do?



Question 6



You notice the same type of mistake happening repeatedly between the Customer Support team and chargeback team.



How would you handle it?



Final Note



We are looking for someone who is organized, reliable, communicative, detail-oriented, and excellent at following clear SOPs.



This is extremely important to us.



You will receive clear instructions and processes, but we need someone who can follow them consistently without needing to be reminded every day.



We want someone who communicates when something is wrong, follows up when something is missing, keeps their work organized, documents everything properly, meets every deadline, and takes responsibility for their tasks.



If this describes the way you work, we would like to hear from you.

title: Research assistant – US Government Contracting
description:
PDFs of the below requirements as well as a blank Excel spreadsheet may be viewed at:





I LOOK FORWARD TO SEEING YOUR WORK.



Research assistant – US Government Contracting:  

1. Find senior finance and legal professionals in U.S. government contracting from public sources only, to a written criteria sheet.  

a. You never call,
, or contact any candidate for any reason.  

2. Deliver the professionals research data in an MS Excel file.  

a. One row per person.  Sorted by grade, A’s on top.  One line of evidence per score.  No evidence, mark it as a question mark (?).  

3. Fluent in English.   Available to begin Monday, November 16, 2026.  

4. Proficiency required in the following software platforms:  LinkedIn, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Word,
 and zoom.  

5. Familiarity with the GoHighLevel CRM a plus.  

a. Data entry into CRM will be required once the research phase is running.  

6. This is a test-first engagement.  No test submission, no hire.  

a. The first activity is to find 10 CFO names off a one-page CFO criteria sheet, delivered in Excel as stated above.   Due Friday end of day.  

b. Ultimately, will want 50 quality sets of names per workday.



CFO Search Criteria

1.	CPA, active.  

     a.	Provide license number and status where the state board shows it.  

          i.	google search “cpaverify” for status.

2.	Big-4 accounting experience.   

     a.	Work experience at one of PricewaterhouseCoopers, Ernst & Young, KPMG or Deloitte.

     b.	Prefer to have the people have worked in the areas of 

          i.	Audit, with government contractor clients.  (DCAA, FAR, CAS).  

          ii.	Transaction services:  financial due diligence and quality of earnings (QoE).  Deal advisory, transaction services, FDD.

          iii.	Government contracts advisory for contractors.  CAS compliance, DCAA readiness, incurred cost submissions, indirect rate structures, contractor accounting system reviews.  

          iv.	Post merger integration.  Folding a bought company’s finance function into yours.  

     c.	Prefer to NOT have the people have their experience in the areas of 

          i.	Tax, any sort of tax.  Corporate, international, transfer pricing, state and local, private client.  

          ii.	Public sector work where the agency is the client.  

          iii.	Audit in industries with no GovCon tie.  Banks, retail, hospitals, insurance.  

          iv.	Management, strategy and technology consulting.  ERP rollouts, operations, human capital, org design.  

          v.	Actuarial, pensions, sustainability and ESG assurance.  

3.	GovCon, contractor side.

     a.	CFO or controller at a government contractor.   DCAA, indirect rates.  

4.	M&A (mergers and acquisition) or DEALS, buy-side preferred.

     a.	Sell-side counts.  Diligence and integration count.  

5.	Available.

     a.	Retired, fractional, or between seats.  Not buried in a full-time job with a conflict.  



Search for the above five criteria.  For each of the 5 criteria, if the requirement is met give it a “1.”   If the criteria are NOT met, give it a “0.”  If you can’t tell or don’t know, put a “?.”  

The sum of the scores is the rank.   If CPA = 1, BIG4 = 1, GovCon = 0, DEALS = 1, Available=?  

The sum for this person would be 1+1+0+1+?= 3+.  



Any question marks that are on a sum that is 2 or higher, I will accept and ask about on the call that I have with this person.   There are no fractional scores.  A person either has a trait (1), they don’t (0) or you don’t know or can’t tell (?).  



The sum of the scores is the rank.  A = 5, B = 4, C = 3, D = 2, F = 1, Z = 0.  

The rank for the above person would be C/C+ at least, and the ? would get answered on my call with this person.

title: Google flow/Veo3 video editor   AI Video Generation
description:
AI Video Creator & Short-Form Editor — Veo 3, Nano Banana, CapCut, Elevenlabs, ChatGPT

Create health and wellness reels and UGC videos.



I run a fast-growing
 and Instagram health and wellness brand built around a consistent AI avatar, along with a growing network of additional social media pages.



I am looking for an **experienced AI video creator and editor** who can take a script and turn it into high-quality, realistic short-form content from start to finish.



**This is NOT a training role.**



You should already be comfortable working with the tools below and be able to start producing quality content with minimal hand-holding.



The three biggest things I care about are:



* **Following instructions exactly**

* **Making the videos look as realistic as possible**

* **Communicating clearly and consistently**



If I provide a reference video, avatar image, product image, editing example, or specific instructions, I expect those details to be followed closely.



## TOOLS YOU MUST ALREADY KNOW



### Veo 3 / Google Flow / Capcut



You should know how to:



* Generate high-quality, photorealistic AI videos from written prompts

* Create realistic human movement, expressions, gestures, and speech

* Maintain consistent characters between clips

* Create vertical short-form content ready for Instagram and

* Match the pacing, camera angles, movements, and overall feel of reference videos

* Troubleshoot poor generations and improve prompts without needing constant guidance



### Veo3 / Nano Banana



You should have strong experience with:



* Nano Banana 1

* Nano Banana 2

* Nano Banana Pro

* Veo3

* Google Flow image generation and video generation

*Capcut



You should understand when to use each model depending on the task.



You must be able to generate **hyper-realistic images** while maintaining:



* Consistent facial identity

* Accurate clothing

* Accurate products

* Realistic hands

* Realistic skin texture

* Natural lighting

* Correct proportions

* Consistent environments



The goal is for viewers to have difficulty immediately recognizing that the content is AI-generated.



### CapCut



You should be highly comfortable editing short-form vertical content in CapCut.



You should know how to:



* Match a reference video's editing style closely

* Add and style captions

* Match fonts, placement, sizing, and timing

* Sync music properly

* Remove dead space

* Create tight cuts

* Color correct footage

* Match pacing

* Add overlays and product comparisons

* Make AI-generated footage feel like natural creator content



If I send you a reference video, you should be able to study it and recreate the editing style without needing every small detail explained.



---



# DAILY WORKFLOW



You will receive a script along with any necessary instructions, reference videos, avatar images, product images, or inspiration.



From there, you handle the entire production process:



**Script → Image Generation → Video Generation → Voice → Editing → Finished Video**



This includes:



1. Generating the necessary images with Nano Banana/Higgsfield

2. Creating realistic clips using Veo 3, Flow, HeyGen, or Grok

3. Keeping the avatar consistent

4. Keeping the voice consistent

5. Creating realistic product shots

6. Editing everything together in CapCut

7. Adding captions, music, overlays, and pacing

8. Delivering a finished vertical video that is ready to post



You must be able to deliver a **minimum of 6 finished videos per day**, approximately **5–6 days per week**.



Once you understand the format and style, the workflow is designed to be fast and repeatable.



---



# REALISM IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



I do not want videos that look like polished AI commercials.



Most of the content should feel like a real person casually filming on an iPhone.



That means paying attention to small details such as:



* Natural facial expressions

* Realistic blinking

* Natural hand gestures

* Realistic product handling

* Correct fingers and hands

* Slight camera movement

* Natural body movement

* Realistic lighting

* Accurate product packaging

* Consistent environments

* Consistent avatar appearance

* Consistent voice

* Natural speech pacing



You should notice these problems yourself and fix them rather than waiting for me to point out every issue.



---



# FOLLOWING INSTRUCTIONS



This is one of the most important parts of the role.



I will often provide very specific instructions about:



* Avatar appearance

* Clothing

* Store/location

* Camera angles

* Product placement

* Product images

* Dialogue

* Voice

* Editing

* Captions

* Reference videos

* Clip pacing



I need someone who actually reads everything carefully and follows those instructions.



If I say to use a specific reference product, store, avatar, voice, or editing style, I should not have to repeat it several times.



Attention to detail is extremely important.



---



# COMMUNICATION



You must be:



* Reliable

* Responsive

* Organized

* Easy to communicate with

* Comfortable asking a question when something is genuinely unclear

* Able to provide updates when needed

* Able to receive feedback without taking it personally

* Able to quickly correct mistakes



If there is a problem with a generation, missing asset, tool issue, or deadline, communicate it immediately instead of disappearing.



I am looking for someone I can work with consistently and trust with a high volume of content.



---



# WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR



You should have:



* Proven hands-on experience with **Veo 3**

* Experience with **Google Flow**

* Deep familiarity with **Nano Banana 1, Nano Banana 2, and Nano Banana Pro**

* Strong **CapCut** editing skills

* Strong prompt-writing ability

* Ability to maintain consistent AI characters

* Ability to generate realistic product shots

* Ability to recreate reference videos

* Ability to create completely new video concepts from scripts and inspiration

* Ability to work independently

* Ability to follow detailed instructions

* Strong attention to realism

* Strong communication

* High output capacity



You must be able to produce **5-6 finished videos per day, 5–6 days per week.**



---



# WHEN APPLYING



Please include:



* Examples of AI videos you have personally created

* Examples using Veo 3

* Examples of Nano Banana

* Examples of realistic AI avatars

* Examples of short-form editing

* Examples showing realistic product placement or product handling if available



Also briefly explain which tools you use most often and your experience with:



**Veo 3, Google Flow, Nano Banana 1/2/Pro, Chatgpt, and CapCut.**



I am looking for someone who can come in and **produce high-quality content from day one.**

2. Cost per qualified call booked on the agency's own book-a-call funnel

I'll share the current numbers and the ceilings at interview.



What you'll do

You run high-ticket book-a-call funnels on Meta, the same way across every account:

• Set up and run conversion campaigns to the booking or application page. You own targeting, budgets, bids and daily optimisation.

• Test new ads every week and switch off the ones that stop producing.

• Tag every lead with source, campaign and creative, so every booked call and every sale traces back to the ad that produced it.

• Report the numbers every day: spend, leads, cost per lead, cost per qualified call, and the one thing you changed.



1. High-ticket campaigns for clients and us. Our and client accounts at a time, each a book-a-call or application funnel for a premium offer. Every account has its own ceiling, agreed with the client. Your targets here are cost per lead, cost per application and cost per qualified call booked, per account.

2. Tracking that holds up. For every funnel, you set up the Meta dataset and tracking codes: the pixel and Conversions API (CAPI), standard events, UTM naming and CRM webhooks, so every lead, booked call and sale traces back to the ad that produced it. When a number looks off, you check the tracking before you touch the budget.

3. The numbers, every day. One end-of-day report in five lines per account: spend, leads, cost per lead, cost per qualified call booked, and the one thing you changed. One weekly review with Markus: what to kill, keep and scale, account by account. Non-negotiable

4. AI does the grunt work. You use AI tools daily for creative variations, ad copy, landing-page tests, audience research and reporting. One person with AI replaces the copywriter, designer and analyst we would otherwise need.



Tools you'll use: Meta Ads Manager, the HighLevel-based CRM for leads and pipeline, Google Sheets for the lead tracker, and whichever AI tools you already work with.



Who we're looking for

Must-haves (all four):

• You have personally managed SGD 3,000+ a month on Meta for at least a year, with the account access to prove it

• You know your numbers by heart: ask you cost per lead, cost per call and show-up rate on your last campaign

• You use AI tools every day for copy, creative and analysis, and can show us what you've built with them

• You communicate clearly and proactively. A daily end-of-day report, every working day, is non-negotiable — no chasing, no going quiet when a number is bad



Nice-to-haves:

• You've run high-ticket book-a-call or application funnels, not just lead forms

• You've managed more than one ad account at the same time, with different offers and ceilings

• You've worked with HighLevel, Zapier, Hyros or n8n

• You've set up Meta datasets, pixels and Conversions API (CAPI) yourself, not just worked in accounts where it was done for you



This job is not for you if:

• You want to manage social media posts and count likes and shares. Here, only booked calls and sales count, and both are tracked.

• You wait to be told what to test next. I expect you to bring the next test to me.

• You want one account to babysit. You'll run several at once, each with its own ceiling, and switching between them is the job.

• You want a standard 9-to-6 job. This job is about hitting numbers, not clocking hours, and you'll need to work weekends from time to time — when client spend is high, you check and report the numbers.

• You don't want to own an outcome. Every ad you run has a cost per qualified call against your name, and we review it weekly.



What you get

• Salary plus a performance bonus. You own a result and get paid for moving it. Figures at interview.

• Work anytime, anywhere. I judge outcomes, not hours or location. Just be contactable during Singapore working hours.

• Clock real experience on real ad spend, across industries. Five figures a month across several live accounts and offers. You'll run more real tests across more niches in your first quarter here than most buyers run in a year, and you won't wait for sign-off to launch one.

• Learn from the best. I review your numbers with you weekly, and you get access to the media-buying and business advisors I've paid close to 6-figures SGD to work with. Their playbooks and their feedback on your campaigns will skyrocket your skills.

• AI does the boring work. No resizing banners. No writing twelve headlines by hand. We pay for your AI tools, and you're free to try new ones whenever you like.

• Career progression. As the agency grows, you move up to higher-level work: funnel strategy, offers, new channels. And if you want to lead, you build and run the buying team under you.

title: Senior Expert SEO / AEO / GEO & Google Business Page and Ads — Plastic Surgery
description:
**IMMEDIATE HIRE NEEDED**



AP Aesthetics is a growing plastic, reconstructive, and aesthetic surgery practice based in Southlake, Texas, serving the Dallas–Fort Worth metropolitan area and patients traveling nationally for specialized surgical care.



We are seeking an experienced Senior SEO, AI Search Optimization, and Paid Digital Advertising Specialist to take ownership of our online visibility, organic search performance, Google Business Profile, and paid advertising campaigns.



Our objective is to become one of the most prominent plastic surgery practices in Dallas–Fort Worth across Google Search, Google Maps, AI-generated recommendations, and procedure-specific searches.



This is a senior, hands-on position, not a general virtual assistant or entry-level social media role.



We have hired a dedicated Business Systems and Automation Developer who manages our website functionality, Microsoft 365, APIs, CRM integrations, and technical development. You will work directly with this developer to optimize our website, implement tracking, develop marketing campaigns, and improve our digital presence.



We want someone who independently identifies opportunities, implements solutions, and demonstrates measurable results.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



SEARCH ENGINE OPTIMIZATION (SEO)



Conduct comprehensive technical, on-page, and off-page SEO audits.



Develop competitive SEO strategies targeting plastic surgery and aesthetic procedures throughout Dallas–Fort Worth.



Perform advanced keyword research, competitor analysis, search-intent mapping, and content-gap analysis.



Optimize website titles, metadata, headings, internal links, URLs, images, schema markup, and website architecture.



Collaborate with our developer to improve Core Web Vitals, mobile performance, indexing, crawlability, redirects, and technical SEO.



Develop and optimize procedure pages, physician profiles, educational resources, and appropriate location-specific pages.



Implement ethical link-building and digital PR strategies to strengthen our practice's online authority.



Monitor organic rankings, website traffic, qualified leads, and consultation conversions.



AI SEARCH OPTIMIZATION (AEO / GEO)



Improve our visibility in Google AI Overviews, AI Mode, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and other AI-powered search platforms.



Develop strategies that make our practice, physicians, credentials, and specialized surgical services accurately discoverable and attributable.



Optimize content structure, expert authorship, entity recognition, structured data, and authoritative references.



Identify search queries where competing plastic surgeons are recommended but our practice is absent.



Track AI-generated brand mentions, citations, and search visibility.



Repurpose physician-led podcasts, transcripts, educational videos, and clinical expertise into original, medically accurate website content.



Our content must reflect our actual surgeon, experience, and practice. We are not interested in generic, mass-produced AI articles.



LOCAL SEO AND GOOGLE BUSINESS PROFILE



Fully optimize and maintain our Google Business Profile.



Improve Google Maps visibility and local search rankings.



Maintain accurate business information, categories, services, photos, and practice updates.



Develop compliant reputation management and patient review strategies.



Manage local business citations, directories, and consistent business information.



Monitor local search performance throughout Southlake, Dallas, Fort Worth, Grapevine, Keller, Westlake, and surrounding communities.



GOOGLE ADS AND PAID SEARCH MANAGEMENT



Independently develop, launch, manage, and optimize Google Ads campaigns.



Conduct paid keyword research, geographic targeting, competitor analysis, and negative keyword optimization.



Manage Google Search campaigns and other appropriate advertising formats.



Optimize bidding strategies, campaign budgets, ad copy, landing pages, and conversion paths.



Establish accurate tracking for consultation requests, telephone calls, qualified leads, and confirmed appointments.



Monitor cost per lead, cost per qualified consultation, conversion rates, advertising efficiency, and lead quality.



Recommend advertising budget adjustments based on actual performance.



We require demonstrated experience managing meaningful Google Ads budgets and improving campaign performance.



ANALYTICS, PIXELS, AND CONVERSION TRACKING



Configure and maintain Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Search Console, and Google Ads conversion tracking.



Coordinate with our developer regarding Meta Pixel, Meta Conversions API, TikTok Pixel, and other approved advertising integrations.



Implement geographic targeting and appropriate geofencing strategies where permitted.



Establish UTM tracking, campaign attribution, event tracking, and reporting.



Coordinate with our designated CRM to measure the lead journey from search or advertisement to consultation booking.



Identify and correct duplicate conversions, missing tracking events, and inaccurate reporting.



Ensure all tracking and advertising practices comply with applicable HIPAA requirements, healthcare advertising rules, privacy regulations, and platform policies.



CONTENT MARKETING AND CONVERSION OPTIMIZATION



Develop an SEO-driven content calendar covering plastic surgery, aesthetic medicine, and specialized reconstructive procedures.



Work with our surgeon and marketing staff to develop credible, medically reviewed educational content.



Optimize website calls to action, consultation forms, booking buttons, landing pages, and conversion funnels.



Recommend improvements to website user experience and patient acquisition workflows.



Coordinate with video editors and social media personnel to repurpose content for YouTube, Instagram,
, TikTok, and our website.



Ensure social media and video content support our broader search visibility and lead-generation objectives.



ADDITIONAL SKILLS — HIGHLY DESIRABLE



Graphic design using Canva, Photoshop, Illustrator, or Figma.



Landing page design and conversion rate optimization.



WordPress SEO and technical website optimization.



Google Ads certification.



Meta Ads Manager and Meta Business Suite experience.



YouTube SEO and YouTube Shorts optimization.



CRM experience.



Social media marketing and content repurposing.



Looker Studio, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, and other professional SEO tools.



Experience working with plastic surgery, dermatology, medical aesthetics, cosmetic medicine, or other competitive healthcare practices.



Graphic design and social media experience are valuable complementary skills, but advanced SEO, AEO/GEO, and Google Ads expertise are the primary requirements.



MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS



At least five years of substantial professional SEO experience, preferably in competitive U.S. markets.



Proven experience personally managing and optimizing Google Ads campaigns.



Strong knowledge of technical SEO, local SEO, keyword research, and conversion tracking.



Familiarity with modern AI search optimization strategies.



Ability to independently audit websites and recommend actionable improvements.



Experience collaborating with website developers and automation specialists.



Excellent written English and communication skills.



Ability to use analytics and performance data to guide decisions.



Availability for 40-50 dedicated hours per week, with at least five hours of daily overlap with U.S. Central Time business hours.



Willingness to disclose existing employment or client commitments and comply with our outside-engagement, confidentiality, and data security requirements.



FIRST 30 DAYS — EXPECTED DELIVERABLES



Complete a comprehensive website SEO, AI search visibility, Google Business Profile, and Google Ads audit.



Perform competitor research and keyword opportunity analysis for DFW plastic surgery.



Identify high-priority technical, content, and local search improvements.



Develop a coordinated implementation plan with our systems developer.



Audit analytics, pixels, conversion tracking, and campaign attribution.



Present a prioritized 90-day marketing strategy with measurable objectives and realistic milestones.



ONGOING PERFORMANCE MEASURES



Organic search visibility for priority procedures and locations.



Google Maps and local search performance.



Qualified organic and paid leads.



Consultation bookings and lead-to-consultation conversion rates.



Google Ads efficiency and lead quality.



AI search visibility, relevant brand mentions, and citations.



Consistent monthly performance reporting with actionable recommendations.



HOW TO APPLY



Please provide the following:



Your resume and professional portfolio.



Two or three websites where you personally led SEO improvements, with measurable before-and-after results.



Examples of Google Ads campaigns you managed, including approximate budgets, conversion metrics, and outcomes.



A brief explanation of how you would improve a plastic surgery practice's rankings in Google Search, Google Maps, and AI-generated recommendations.



Your experience with GA4, GTM, Google Search Console, Meta Pixel, Conversions API, and marketing attribution.



Your experience collaborating with website developers and CRM automation specialists.



Any graphic design, content creation, or social media marketing experience.



Confirmation that you accept $1800 USD/month, can provide 40-50 dedicated hours per week, and can maintain at least five hours of overlap with U.S. Central Time.



To confirm that you read this posting, begin your application with the phrase: DFW SEARCH STRATEGY.



We will prioritize candidates who provide verifiable performance results, specific project examples, and clear explanations of work they personally performed.



Selected applicants will be invited to a technical interview and may be asked to complete a short paid assessment using publicly available website and search information.



We are looking for a long-term specialist who will take genuine ownership of our digital growth, not someone who simply produces generic SEO reports or follows a checklist.

title: Dry Van & Reefer Freight Dispatcher — Virtual Assistant
description:
WE ARE HIRING

Dry Van & Reefer Freight Dispatcher — Virtual Assistant



Company: True Profit Dispatch  

Website: 
  

Position: U.S. Freight Dispatcher (Dry Van & Reefer)  

Engagement: Independent Contractor  

Location: 100% Remote — International Applicants Welcome  

Compensation: Proposed $6–$9 USD per hour, based on experience, plus performance-based incentives  

Availability: Must be available to coordinate dispatch activities during agreed U.S. business-hour coverage periods



About True Profit Dispatch



True Profit Dispatch is a U.S.-focused freight dispatching business specializing in helping trucking companies and owner-operators operate efficiently and profitably.



We are seeking an experienced, dependable, and highly motivated **Dry Van & Reefer Freight Dispatcher** who understands U.S. trucking markets, negotiates effectively with freight brokers, and prioritizes driver profitability.



We are not looking for someone who simply books loads. We want a dispatcher who understands the difference between keeping a truck moving and keeping a truck profitable.



Key Responsibilities



1. Load Searching and Booking

- Search DAT, Truckstop, and other authorized freight load boards.

- Find profitable loads for both dry van and refrigerated trailers.

- Evaluate rates using total miles, including loaded and deadhead miles.

- Identify strong and weak freight markets.

- Plan profitable routes and return loads.

- Verify broker credentials, payment history, and load details.

- Review rate confirmations before booking.



2. Broker Negotiations

- Communicate professionally with U.S. freight brokers by phone and
.

- Negotiate competitive rates based on current freight conditions.

- Prepare and present effective counteroffers.

- Identify opportunities for higher-paying freight.

- Negotiate detention, layover, additional stops, and other accessorial charges.

- Build productive, long-term relationships with reliable brokers.

- Avoid booking loads that do not meet agreed profitability requirements without authorization.



3. Dry Van Dispatch Operations

- Coordinate general freight shipments and delivery schedules.

- Verify equipment requirements and shipment details.

- Monitor pickup and delivery appointments.

- Coordinate with drivers regarding routes and load status.

- Resolve scheduling conflicts and report service issues.

- Monitor detention and layover opportunities.



4. Reefer Dispatch Operations

- Book temperature-controlled freight.

- Confirm commodity requirements, temperature setpoints, and reefer operating instructions.

- Coordinate reefer trailer availability, washouts, and fuel requirements.

- Monitor pickup and delivery appointments.

- Maintain accurate seal, temperature, and shipment documentation.

- Escalate temperature discrepancies and potential cargo claims.



5. Driver and Broker Communication**

- Maintain timely communication with drivers and brokers.

- Provide shipment updates and appointment confirmations.

- Coordinate delays and operational issues.

- Respect driver hours-of-service limitations.

- Escalate safety, mechanical, and compliance concerns.



6. Reporting and Administrative Support**

- Maintain accurate load records in Excel or Google Sheets.

- Update dispatch dashboards and truck availability information.

- Record gross revenue, loaded miles, deadhead, and booked RPM.

- Track detention, layover, and accessorial payments.

- Organize rate confirmations, bills of lading, and proof-of-delivery documents.

- Prepare daily status reports and weekly performance summaries.



Minimum Qualifications



- At least 1 year of U.S. freight dispatching experience preferred.

- Experience with both dry van and reefer freight strongly preferred.

- Familiarity with DAT, Truckstop, or comparable freight load boards.

- Strong knowledge of U.S. freight lanes and trucking geography.

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Confident broker negotiation and telephone communication skills.

- Ability to calculate gross RPM and understand cost-per-mile profitability.

- Proficiency in Excel, Google Sheets,
, and digital communication.

- Reliable high-speed internet and professional remote work setup.

- Strong time management, problem-solving, and organizational skills.



Preferred Experience



- Dispatching owner-operators and small trucking fleets.

- Reefer commodity and temperature requirements.

- Booking profitable return loads.

- Managing multiple trucks.

- Broker credit and authority verification.

- Detention and layover recovery.

- Familiarity with the Southeast, Midwest, Texas, Northeast, and Western U.S. freight markets.



Performance Expectations



Contractor performance will be evaluated using agreed service and business outcomes, including:



- Profitability of booked freight.

- Quality of broker negotiations.

- Reduction of avoidable deadhead.

- Load documentation accuracy.

- Effective driver and broker communication.

- Appointment and shipment coordination.

- Timely reporting.

- Consistent adherence to agreed dispatch procedures and safety requirements.



Compensation and Engagement



- Proposed rate: $6–$9 USD per hour, depending on demonstrated experience.

- Performance-based bonuses may be offered under separately agreed criteria.

- Initial paid trial engagement.

- Opportunity for an ongoing service relationship.

- Independent contractor agreement required.



The contractor is responsible for applicable independent-business and tax obligations, subject to governing law.



How to Apply



Applicants should submit:



1. Resume and relevant dispatching experience.

2. Description of dry van and reefer freight experience.

3. Freight load boards previously used.

4. Number of trucks previously managed.

5. Example of a successful broker rate negotiation.

6. Expected hourly rate and U.S. business-hour availability.

7. A short response to the following scenario:



Dispatcher Assessment:



A broker offers $2,400 for a dry van load with 900 loaded miles and 100 deadhead miles. Explain how you would evaluate the load, negotiate the rate, and assess the destination market.



Application
: 



Subject: Dry Van & Reefer Dispatcher — Independent Contractor



True Profit Dispatch — Dispatching for Profit, Not Just Miles.

*Proactively manage filing deadlines and identify missing information or potential compliance issues.



Tax Planning & Strategy

*Prepare comprehensive federal and state income tax projections for business owners and their entities throughout the year.

*Identify and evaluate tax-saving opportunities involving entity structures, owner compensation, retirement plans, deductions, credits, distributions, and other planning strategies.

*Research advanced tax issues involving multiple business entities and overlapping individual and business tax considerations.

*Model alternative strategies and calculate their financial and tax implications.

*Prepare detailed calculations and clear strategy recommendations for founder review.

*Monitor legislative and regulatory changes affecting our clients.

*Assist with implementing approved tax strategies and monitoring their results.



Payroll & Accounting Coordination

*Process monthly payroll through our payroll software.

*Review quarterly and annual federal and state payroll tax filings for accuracy and completeness.

*Prepare manual payroll tax filings for specialized client arrangements, including family management companies.

*Reconcile payroll records, tax liabilities, employee compensation, and bookkeeping accounts.

*Review payroll-related adjusting journal entries and year-end accounting records.

*Ensure accurate reporting of shareholder compensation, payroll deductions, benefits, and other tax-sensitive payroll transactions.

*Coordinate with the bookkeeping team to resolve discrepancies and maintain accurate financial records.



Tax Operations & Team Collaboration

*Independently manage assigned projects, priorities, and deadlines.

*Maintain accurate project status and documentation in our practice management systems.

*Follow established quality control procedures and identify opportunities to improve them.

*Develop and refine standard operating procedures, templates, and internal workflows.

*Identify opportunities to streamline tax preparation, research, projections, and compliance through technology and automation.

*Participate in team meetings, training, and professional development.



EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS REQUIRED:

*Minimum 5 years of , including substantial experience preparing individual and business returns. Candidates with 8–12 years of experience are especially encouraged to apply.

*Extensive experience preparing US federal individual and business tax returns, including Forms 1040, 1120, 1120-S, and 1065.

*Proficiency in using Tax software. Experience in Intuit ProConnect Tax Online is a huge advantage.

*Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex calculations, reconciliations, and financial analysis.

*Experience working with US accounting firms and/or US-based clients.

*Strong working knowledge of US federal tax law and relevant state tax requirements.

*Experience with pass-through entities, shareholder and partner basis, business structures, and individual tax considerations.

*Ability to prepare tax returns independently, evaluate technical accuracy, and identify matters requiring further research or review.

*Strong research and analytical skills, including the ability to interpret tax guidance and document conclusions.

*Experience preparing tax projections and supporting tax planning recommendations.

*Familiarity with US payroll processing, payroll tax compliance, and accounting reconciliations.

*Excellent written and spoken English.

*Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines.

*Reliable high-speed internet, a suitable remote workspace, and backup equipment/connectivity.



Preferred Qualifications

*Philippine Certified Public Accountant (CPA) credential.

*Active US Enrolled Agent (EA) credential.

*Experience with a Big Four accounting firm or established US public accounting firm.

*Advanced experience in tax planning for closely held businesses, high-income individuals, and multientity structures.

*Experience preparing multistate individual and business tax returns.

*Experience conducting technical reviews of returns prepared by other accountants.

*Familiarity with tax workflow automation, AI-assisted research, and accounting technology.



WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO

*Thinks beyond the return. You understand that tax preparation is only one part of effective tax planning. You’re naturally curious about opportunities to improve a client’s overall financial position.

*Takes ownership. You don’t need someone constantly checking your progress. You anticipate deadlines, resolve problems, and follow through.

*Has excellent technical judgment. You’re confident in your expertise, but you know when to research, ask questions, or challenge an assumption.

*Loves the details. You enjoy untangling complicated financial records, finding discrepancies, and getting the numbers exactly right.

*Communicates clearly. You can explain complicated tax matters in straightforward language and provide organized, actionable recommendations.

*Enjoys improving systems. You’re always looking for a more accurate, efficient, or effective way to complete work.

*Values collaboration and independence. You enjoy being part of a small, capable team where your contributions matter.

*Takes work seriously without taking yourself too seriously. You care about excellence, enjoy what you do, and believe there’s more to life than work.



Tech Requirements:

title: Virtual Assistant — Client Acquisition & Order Coordination
description:
Virtual Assistant — Client Acquisition & Order Coordination



Company: MaxYoMind LLC — Custom Printing & Embroidery. Location: Remote (company based in Mount Laurel, NJ; Eastern Time hours). Type: Part-time, 20 hours per week. Compensation: $3.50 per hour, plus a $25 bonus for every order you help close. For orders over $1,000, you earn 2% commission on the order total instead of the $25 bonus.



About MaxYoMind: MaxYoMind is a custom printing and embroidery company in Mount Laurel, New Jersey. We produce custom apparel and printed goods — embroidery, screen printing, DTF printing, heat-transfer vinyl, custom hats and caps, team uniforms, jackets, and paper/memorial printing — for local businesses, churches, schools, sports teams, organizations, and individuals. We are also building a youth vocational training program inside our shop. We are quote-based: customers request a quote, approve a mockup, pay by invoice, and we produce in-house. We are hiring a Virtual Assistant to grow the front of the business — finding customers, taking orders, marketing the company, and making sure every order is fulfilled and gets to the customer. Production itself is done by our in-house team; this role owns everything before and after the machines run.



The Role in One Sentence: You are the engine that brings in customers and the coordinator who makes sure no order — from first message to the customer's hands — ever falls through the cracks.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Finding Customers (Lead Generation & Outreach): Research and build prospect lists of businesses and organizations that need custom printing: churches, schools, sports leagues and teams, restaurants and delis, realtors, construction and service companies, nonprofits, event organizers, and local retailers. Run outreach campaigns by
, phone, and social media DMs following company scripts and templates: introduce MaxYoMind, identify the decision-maker, and book quote requests. Follow up on every lead systematically — most orders come after the second or third touch, not the first. Watch for institutional opportunities: school and government bid notices, team uniform seasons, church and organizational events, and seasonal demand. Keep the prospect/lead tracker current: who was contacted, when, what they said, and the next follow-up date.

2. Marketing the Business: Prepare marketing content for the company's social media (Instagram,
, TikTok): captions, post ideas, and content calendars featuring finished work, services, and promotions — for the owner's review and posting process. Draft
 outreach and follow-up campaigns to past customers and new prospects. Keep online listings accurate and active and flag review opportunities. Track what works: report weekly on outreach volume, responses, quotes generated, and content performance.

3. Taking Orders (Intake & Quoting Support): Respond to inquiries fast — same business day, ideally within the hour during work hours — by
, phone, and website form. Gather complete order details from customers: items, quantities, sizes, colors, artwork/logo files, deadlines, and delivery method. Coordinate artwork and mockups with the production team and send them to customers for approval. Prepare quotes from the company's price menus and send invoices (Square) once the customer approves. Confirm payment status before an order is released to production.

4. Making Sure Orders Are Fulfilled & Reach the Customer: Track every open order on the order board: status, deadline, blanks status, production stage, and next action — reviewed daily. Coordinate blank-garment ordering with suppliers (e.g., SanMar) so materials are in hand before production dates; flag stock problems and confirm substitutes with customers early. Chase anything stuck: missing artwork, unapproved mockups, unpaid invoices, out-of-stock items — and escalate to the owner before a deadline is at risk. Arrange customer pickup at the shop, and pack and ship orders for customers who need shipping: prepare shipping labels, confirm addresses, send tracking numbers, and verify delivery. Send completion messages, confirm the customer received everything, and close the order out — including asking for a review and noting reorder potential.

5. Customer Care & Administration: Be the friendly, reliable point of contact. Handle routine questions about services, pricing ranges, turnaround, and order policies (all confirmed orders are final — store credit only). Maintain organized records: orders, invoices, artwork files, and customer history.



What This Role Does NOT Do: No production work — you will not print, stitch, or operate equipment. No spending or ordering on company accounts beyond what the owner approves. No public posts, ads, or commitments go out in the company's name without the owner's approval.



Requirements: 1+ years as a virtual assistant, sales/outreach assistant, customer service representative, or order coordinator. Experience with print shops, apparel, e-commerce, or B2B services is a strong plus. Sales mindset: comfortable doing outreach and follow-ups every day. Organization: you live in trackers and checklists. Communication: clear, professional written English; friendly and confident on the phone and in messages. Tools:
 and Google Workspace, spreadsheets or a CRM, invoicing tools (Square is a plus), social media platforms (Instagram,
, TikTok), and basic file handling for artwork (PNG / PDF / JPG). Reliability: available during Eastern Time business hours (shop hours Mon–Fri 11 AM–7 PM, Sat 10 AM–7 PM ET), responsive, and consistent. Integrity: customer lists, pricing, and business information are confidential.

About Us

We are looking for an experienced IRS Enrolled Agent (EA) to join our tax resolution team remotely. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience dealing directly with the IRS, obtaining transcripts, resolving tax debts, and representing taxpayers before the IRS.



This is a long-term opportunity with a well-established American company.



Key Responsibilities



IRS Representation & Tax Resolution



* Represent clients before the IRS using Form 2848 (Power of Attorney).

* Contact the IRS Practitioner Priority Service (PPS) to discuss client accounts, collection holds, balances, and resolution options.

* Prepare and negotiate Offers in Compromise (OIC).

* Handle Currently Not Collectible (CNC) cases.

* Request penalty abatements and resolve IRS notices.

* Communicate with IRS Revenue Officers and other IRS representatives.



IRS Transcripts & Compliance



* Obtain IRS Account Transcripts and Wage & Income Transcripts through authorized IRS channels.

* Work with Forms 2848 and 8821.

* Identify unfiled tax returns and outstanding tax liabilities.

* Review IRS collection activity, liens, levies, and garnishments.

* Verify taxpayer compliance before submitting resolutions.



Tax Preparation & Documentation



* Assist with preparing delinquent federal and state tax returns, including Forms 1040, Schedule C, and business returns.

* Review financial statements, bank statements, pay stubs, and supporting documents.

* Prepare IRS financial disclosure forms, including Forms 433-A, 433-A(OIC), and 433-F.

* Maintain accurate client records, case notes, and task updates in our case management platform, LOGICS.



Required Qualifications



* Active IRS Enrolled Agent (EA) credential – strongly preferred.

* Active PTIN and experience working with IRS CAF authorizations.

* Experience calling IRS Practitioner Priority Service (PPS).

* Familiarity with IRS e-Services and Tax Pro Account.

* Proven experience with IRS tax resolution, especially OIC, CNC, and installment agreements.

* Excellent spoken and written English.

* Ability to work independently during U.S. business hours.

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

* Ability to handle confidential taxpayer information securely.



Candidates without an EA credential may be considered for non-representative support positions if they have substantial IRS transcript and tax resolution experience.



Compensation & Benefits



* Fixed salary: $1,540 USD per month

* Full-time remote employment, 40 hours per week.

* Long-term, stable opportunity.

* Training on our internal procedures and LOGICS case management platform.

* Opportunity for increased responsibilities based on performance.



How to Apply



Start your application with “EA-READY” and answer the following questions:



1. Are you currently an IRS Enrolled Agent? When did you obtain your license?

2. Do you have an active PTIN and CAF number or experience obtaining CAF authorizations?

3. How many years of IRS tax resolution experience do you have?

4. Have you personally handled Offers in Compromise, CNC cases, and IRS installment agreements?

5. Have you called IRS Practitioner Priority Service and obtained IRS transcripts?

6. Have you prepared Forms 433-A(OIC), 433-F, and 656?

7. Can you work Monday through Friday during U.S. Central Time business hours?

8. Are you comfortable with a fixed salary of $1,540 USD per month?



We are looking for an experienced professional who can independently manage IRS resolution cases, not someone who only prepares tax returns.
